5.114.s:
trijāto brāhmaṇastatra kinnāmā kasya sambhavaḥ ..
kiṃgotraścaiva kiṃsaṃjñaḥ kīrtayasva mahāmate .. 1 ..
5.114.d:
त्रिजातो ब्राह्मणस्तत्र किन्नामा कस्य सम्भवः ..
किंगोत्रश्चैव किंसंज्ञः कीर्तयस्व महामते .. 1 ..
5.114.m: “That brahmin Trijāta there—what was his name, whose son was he, / of what lineage was he, and what was his appellation? Relate [this], O great-minded one.

5.114.s:
kiṃ kulīnairguṇāḍhyairvā tejovidyāvicakṣaṇaiḥ ..
trijāto'pi varaṃ so'pi svaṃ sthānaṃ yena coddhṛtam .. 2 ..
5.114.d:
किं कुलीनैर्गुणाढ्यैर्वा तेजोविद्याविचक्षणैः ..
त्रिजातोऽपि वरं सोऽपि स्वं स्थानं येन चोद्धृतम् .. 2 ..
5.114.m: What of those of noble family, or those rich in virtues, or those discerning in radiance and learning? / Even Trijāta was preferable, by whom his own abode was delivered.”

5.114.s:
sūta uvāca .. .. sāṃkṛtyasya munervaṃśe sa saṃbhūto dvijottamaḥ ..
prabhāva iti vikhyāto dattasaṃjño nimeḥ sutaḥ .. 3 ..
5.114.d:
सूत उवाच .. .. सांकृत्यस्य मुनेर्वंशे स संभूतो द्विजोत्तमः ..
प्रभाव इति विख्यातो दत्तसंज्ञो निमेः सुतः .. 3 ..
5.114.m: Sūta said: / “In the lineage of the sage Sāṅkṛti was that best of the twice-born born; / renowned as Prabhāva, the son of Nimi was given the name [Trijāta].”

5.114.s:
sa evaṃ sthānamuddhṛtya cakārāyatanaṃ śubham ..
trijāteśvaranāmnā ca devadevasya śūlinaḥ .. 4 ..
5.114.d:
स एवं स्थानमुद्धृत्य चकारायतनं शुभम् ..
त्रिजातेश्वरनाम्ना च देवदेवस्य शूलिनः .. 4 ..
5.114.m: Having thus restored the place, he built an auspicious temple / in the name of Trijāteśvara for the trident-bearing God of gods. // 4

5.114.s:
tamārādhya divā naktaṃ samyakchraddhāsamanvitaḥ..
saśarīro gataḥ svargaṃ tataḥ kālena kenacit .. 5 ..
5.114.d:
तमाराध्य दिवा नक्तं सम्यक्छ्रद्धासमन्वितः..
सशरीरो गतः स्वर्गं ततः कालेन केनचित् .. 5 ..
5.114.m: Having worshipped him day and night, fully endowed with faith, / he went to heaven in his bodily form after some time. // 5

5.114.s:
yastaṃ paśyati sadbhaktyā snāpayedviṣuve sadā ..
na trijātaḥ kule tasya kathañcidapi jāyate .. 6 ..
5.114.d:
यस्तं पश्यति सद्भक्त्या स्नापयेद्विषुवे सदा ..
न त्रिजातः कुले तस्य कथञ्चिदपि जायते .. 6 ..
5.114.m: Whoever beholds him with true devotion and bathes him at the equinox, / in his family a trijāta is never born. // 6

5.114.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
yāni gotrāṇi naṣṭāni yāni saṃsthāpitāni ca..
nāmatastāni no brūhi tatpuraṃ sūta nandana .. 7 ..
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
tatropamanyugotrā ye krauṃcagotrasamudbhavāḥ ..
kaiśoryaṃ gotrasaṃbhūtāstraivaṇeyā dvijottamaḥ 8 ..
5.114.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
यानि गोत्राणि नष्टानि यानि संस्थापितानि च..
नामतस्तानि नो ब्रूहि तत्पुरं सूत नन्दन .. 7 ..
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
तत्रोपमन्युगोत्रा ये क्रौंचगोत्रसमुद्भवाः ..
कैशोर्यं गोत्रसंभूतास्त्रैवणेया द्विजोत्तमः 8 ..
5.114.m: The seers said: / Which lineages were lost, and which were re-established— / tell us their names, O son of Sūta, [along with] that city. // 7 // / Sūta said: / There, those of the Upamanyu lineage, those born of the Krauñca lineage, / those born of the Kaiśorya lineage, [and] the Traivaṇeyas, O best of brahmins, // 8

5.114.s:
te bhūyo'pi na saṃprāptā yathā gotracatuṣṭayam ..
tatpūrvakaṃ śukādīnāṃ yannaṣṭaṃ nāgajādbhayāt .. 9 ..
5.114.d:
ते भूयोऽपि न संप्राप्ता यथा गोत्रचतुष्टयम् ..
तत्पूर्वकं शुकादीनां यन्नष्टं नागजाद्भयात् .. 9 ..
5.114.m: those four lineages did not return again, / which, beginning with Śuka and the others, had been lost out of fear of the Nāga. // 9

5.114.s:
śeṣānvaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi brāhmaṇāngotrasaṃbhavān ..
kauśikānvayasaṃ bhūtāḥ ṣaḍviṃśatiśca te smṛtāḥ .. 10 ..
5.114.d:
शेषान्वः संप्रवक्ष्यामि ब्राह्मणान्गोत्रसंभवान् ..
कौशिकान्वयसं भूताः षड्विंशतिश्च ते स्मृताः .. 10 ..
5.114.m: The remaining brahmins born in the lineages I shall describe to you: / those born in the Kauśika line are recalled as twenty-six. // 10

5.114.s:
kaśyapānvayasaṃbhūtāḥ saptāśītirdvijottamāḥ ..
lakṣmaṇānvayasaṃbhūtā ekaviṃśatirāgatāḥ .. 11 ..
5.114.d:
कश्यपान्वयसंभूताः सप्ताशीतिर्द्विजोत्तमाः ..
लक्ष्मणान्वयसंभूता एकविंशतिरागताः .. 11 ..
5.114.m: Those born in the Kaśyapa line are eighty-seven best brahmins; / those born in the Lakṣmaṇa line who arrived are twenty-one. // 11

5.114.s:
tatra naṣṭāḥ punaḥ prāptāstasminsthāne suduḥkhitāḥ ..
bhāradvājāstrayaḥ prāptāḥ kauṃḍanīyāścaturdaśa .. 12 ..
5.114.d:
तत्र नष्टाः पुनः प्राप्तास्तस्मिन्स्थाने सुदुःखिताः ..
भारद्वाजास्त्रयः प्राप्ताः कौंडनीयाश्चतुर्दश .. 12 ..
5.114.m: Those lost there arrived again at that place, deeply grieved: / three Bhāradvājas arrived, and fourteen Kauṇḍinīyas; // 12

5.114.s:
raitikānāṃ tathā viṃśatpārāśaryāṣṭakaṃ tathā ..
gargāṇāṃ ca dviviṃśaṃ ca hārītānāṃ viviṃśatiḥ .. 13 ..
5.114.d:
रैतिकानां तथा विंशत्पाराशर्याष्टकं तथा ..
गर्गाणां च द्विविंशं च हारीतानां विविंशतिः .. 13 ..
5.114.m: twenty of the Raitikas, and eight of the Pārāśaryas; / twenty-two of the Gargas, and twenty of the Hārītas; // 13

5.114.s:
aurvabhārgavagotrāṇāṃ pañcaviṃśadudāhṛtāḥ ..
gautamānāṃ ca ṣaḍviṃśamālūbhāyanaviṃśatiḥ .. 14 ..
5.114.d:
और्वभार्गवगोत्राणां पञ्चविंशदुदाहृताः ..
गौतमानां च षड्विंशमालूभायनविंशतिः .. 14 ..
5.114.m: twenty-five of the Aurva-Bhārgava lineage are declared; / twenty-six of the Gautamas, and twenty Ālūbhāyanas; // 14

5.114.s:
māṃḍavyānāṃ triviṃśacca bahvṛcānāṃ triviṃśatiḥ ..
sāṃkṛtyānāṃ viśiṣṭānāṃ pṛthaktvena daśaiva tu .. 15 ..
5.114.d:
मांडव्यानां त्रिविंशच्च बह्वृचानां त्रिविंशतिः ..
सांकृत्यानां विशिष्टानां पृथक्त्वेन दशैव तु .. 15 ..
5.114.m: twenty-three of the Māṇḍavyas, and twenty-three Bahvṛcas; / of the distinguished Sāṅkṛtyas, exactly ten distinct [families]; // 15

5.114.s:
tathaivāṃgirasānāṃ ca paṃca caiva prakīrtitāḥ ..
ātreyā daśa saṃkhyātāḥ śuklātreyāstathaiva ca .. 16 ..
vātsyāḥ pañca samākhyātāḥ kautsāśca nava sapta vai ..
śāṃḍilyā bhārgavāḥ pañca maudgalyā viṃśatiḥ smṛtāḥ ...7..
baudhāyanāḥ kauśalāśca triṃśanmātrāḥ prakīrtitāḥ ..
atharvāḥ paṃcapaṃcāśanmaunasāḥ saptasaptatiḥ ...8..
5.114.d:
तथैवांगिरसानां च पंच चैव प्रकीर्तिताः ..
आत्रेया दश संख्याताः शुक्लात्रेयास्तथैव च .. 16 ..
वात्स्याः पञ्च समाख्याताः कौत्साश्च नव सप्त वै ..
शांडिल्या भार्गवाः पञ्च मौद्गल्या विंशतिः स्मृताः ...7..
बौधायनाः कौशलाश्च त्रिंशन्मात्राः प्रकीर्तिताः ..
अथर्वाः पंचपंचाशन्मौनसाः सप्तसप्ततिः ...8..
5.114.m:
likewise of the Āṅgirasas, five are proclaimed; / ten Ātreyas are counted, and likewise [ten] Śuklātreyas; // 16
five Vātsyas are proclaimed, and nine [and] seven Kautsas; / five Śāṇḍilya-Bhārgavas, and twenty Maudgalyas are remembered; // 17
Baudhāyanas and Kauśalas are declared to be thirty only; / fifty-five Atharvas, and seventy-seven Maunasas; // 18

5.114.s:
yājuṣāstriṃśatiḥ khyātāścyāvanāḥ sapta viṃśatiḥ ..
āgastyāśca trayastriṃśajjaimineyā daśaiva tu .. 19..
naivṛtāḥ paṃcapaṃcāśatpāṭhīnāḥ saptatirdvijāḥ ..
gobhilāścāpi kākvāśca paṃcapaṃca dvijāḥ smṛtāḥ ..2...
5.114.d:
याजुषास्त्रिंशतिः ख्याताश्च्यावनाः सप्त विंशतिः ..
आगस्त्याश्च त्रयस्त्रिंशज्जैमिनेया दशैव तु .. 19..
नैवृताः पंचपंचाशत्पाठीनाः सप्ततिर्द्विजाः ..
गोभिलाश्चापि काक्वाश्च पंचपंच द्विजाः स्मृताः ..2...
5.114.m:
thirty Yājuṣas are renowned, and twenty-seven Cyāvanas; / thirty-three Āgastyas, and ten Jaimineyas; // 19
fifty-five Naivṛtas, and seventy Pāṭhīna brahmins; / five Gobhilas, and five Kākva brahmins are remembered; // 20

5.114.s:
auśanasāśca dāśārhāstrayastraya udāhṛtāḥ ..
lokākhyānāṃ tathā ṣaṣṭiraiṇiśānāṃ dvisaptatiḥ ..21...
5.114.d:
औशनसाश्च दाशार्हास्त्रयस्त्रय उदाहृताः ..
लोकाख्यानां तथा षष्टिरैणिशानां द्विसप्ततिः ..21...
5.114.m: three Auśanasas, and three Dāśārhas are declared; / sixty of those called Lokākhya, and seventy-two Aiṇiśas; // 21

5.114.s:
kāpiṣṭhalāḥ śārkarākhyā dattākhyāḥ saptasaptatiḥ ..
śārkavānāṃ śataṃ proktaṃ dārjyānāṃ saptasaptatiḥ..22..
5.114.d:
कापिष्ठलाः शार्कराख्या दत्ताख्याः सप्तसप्ततिः ..
शार्कवानां शतं प्रोक्तं दार्ज्यानां सप्तसप्ततिः..22..
5.114.m: seventy-seven of the Kāpiṣṭhalas, Śārkaras, and Dattas; / one hundred of the Śārkavas are declared, and seventy-seven Dārjyas; // 22

5.114.s:
kātyāyanyāstrayo'dhiṣṭhā vaidiśāśca trayaḥ smṛtāḥ ..
kṛṣṇātreyāstathā paṃca dattātreyā stathaiva ca ..23..
5.114.d:
कात्यायन्यास्त्रयोऽधिष्ठा वैदिशाश्च त्रयः स्मृताः ..
कृष्णात्रेयास्तथा पंच दत्तात्रेया स्तथैव च ..23..
5.114.m: three settled Kātyāyanīs, and three Vaidiśas are remembered; / five Kṛṣṇātreyas, and likewise [five] Dattātreyas; // 23

5.114.s:
nārāyaṇāḥ śaunakeyā jābālāḥ śatasaṃkhyayā ..
gopālā jāmadanyāśca śālihotrāśca karṇikāḥ ..24..
5.114.d:
नारायणाः शौनकेया जाबालाः शतसंख्यया ..
गोपाला जामदन्याश्च शालिहोत्राश्च कर्णिकाः ..24..
5.114.m: one hundred in number of Nārāyaṇas, Śaunakeyas, and Jābālas; / Gopālas, Jāmadagnyas, Śālihotras, and Karṇikas; // 24

5.114.s:
bhāgurāyaṇakāścaiva mātṛkāstraiṇavāstathā..
sarve te brāhmaṇaśreṣṭhāḥ krameṇa dvijasattamāḥ ..25..
5.114.d:
भागुरायणकाश्चैव मातृकास्त्रैणवास्तथा..
सर्वे ते ब्राह्मणश्रेष्ठाः क्रमेण द्विजसत्तमाः ..25..
5.114.m: and Bhāgurāyaṇakas, Mātṛkas, and Traiṇavas— / all these foremost brahmins, in order, best of brahmins. // 25

5.114.s:
eteṣāmeva sarveṣāṃ satkārāya dvijotamāḥ ..
catvāriṃśattathāṣṭau ca purā proktāḥ svayaṃbhuvā ..26..
5.114.d:
एतेषामेव सर्वेषां सत्काराय द्विजोतमाः ..
चत्वारिंशत्तथाष्टौ च पुरा प्रोक्ताः स्वयंभुवा ..26..
5.114.m: For the honour of all these alone, O best of brahmins, / forty-eight [rules] were anciently spoken by the self-manifest [Brahmā]. // 26

5.114.s:
te sarve ca pṛthaktvena nirdiṣṭāḥ padmayoninā ..
saṃdhyātarpaṇakṛtyāni vaiśvadevodbhavāni ca ..
śrāddhāni pakṣakṛtyāni pitṛpiṃḍāṃstathaiva ca ..27..
5.114.d:
ते सर्वे च पृथक्त्वेन निर्दिष्टाः पद्मयोनिना ..
संध्यातर्पणकृत्यानि वैश्वदेवोद्भवानि च ..
श्राद्धानि पक्षकृत्यानि पितृपिंडांस्तथैव च ..27..
5.114.m: All of them were separately assigned by the lotus-born [Brahmā]: / rites of twilight worship and water-offerings, rites born of the Vaiśvadeva, / śrāddhas, rites of the lunar fortnights, and ancestor-balls; // 27

5.114.s:
yajñopavītasaṃyuktāḥ pravarāścaiva kṛtsnaśaḥ ..
tathā mauṃjīviśeṣāśca śikhābhedāḥ prakīrtitāḥ .. 28 ..
5.114.d:
यज्ञोपवीतसंयुक्ताः प्रवराश्चैव कृत्स्नशः ..
तथा मौंजीविशेषाश्च शिखाभेदाः प्रकीर्तिताः .. 28 ..
5.114.m: along with the sacred thread, and all the ancestral invocations in full, / as well as the particular girdles of muñja-grass and the distinct tufts of hair are proclaimed. // 28

5.114.s:
trijātena samārādhya devadevaṃ pitāmaham ..
teṣāṃ kṛtvā dvijedrāṇāmātmakīrtikṛte tadā .. 29 ..
5.114.d:
त्रिजातेन समाराध्य देवदेवं पितामहम् ..
तेषां कृत्वा द्विजेद्राणामात्मकीर्तिकृते तदा .. 29 ..
5.114.m: Having worshipped the God of gods, the Grandfather, / the trijāta, for his own renown, then made [these rules] for those lords of brahmins. // 29

5.114.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
kathaṃ santoṣito brahmā trijātena mahātmanā ..
karmakāṃḍaṃ kathaṃ bhinnaṃ kṛtaṃ tena mahātmanā ..
sarvaṃ vistarato brūhi paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi naḥ .. 30 ..
5.114.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
कथं सन्तोषितो ब्रह्मा त्रिजातेन महात्मना ..
कर्मकांडं कथं भिन्नं कृतं तेन महात्मना ..
सर्वं विस्तरतो ब्रूहि परं कौतूहलं हि नः .. 30 ..
5.114.m: The seers said: / How was Brahmā pleased by the great-souled trijāta? / How was the division of ritual actions made by that great-souled one? / Tell everything in full, for our curiosity is great. // 30

5.114.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
tasyārthe brāhmaṇaiḥ sarvaistoṣitaḥ prapitāmahaḥ ..
anenaivoddhṛtaṃ sthānamasmākaṃ sakalaṃ vibho .. 31 ..
5.114.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
तस्यार्थे ब्राह्मणैः सर्वैस्तोषितः प्रपितामहः ..
अनेनैवोद्धृतं स्थानमस्माकं सकलं विभो .. 31 ..
5.114.m: Sūta said: / For his sake, the Great-Grandfather was pleased by all the brahmins [saying]: / 'By him alone our entire abode was restored, O all-pervading Lord. // 31

5.114.s:
tasmādasya vibho yaccha vedajñānamanutamam ..
yena karmaviśeṣāśca jāyate'tra purottame .. 32 ..
5.114.d:
तस्मादस्य विभो यच्छ वेदज्ञानमनुतमम् ..
येन कर्मविशेषाश्च जायतेऽत्र पुरोत्तमे .. 32 ..
5.114.m: Therefore, O all-pervading Lord, give him unsurpassed knowledge of the Veda, / by which the particular rituals may arise here in this best of cities; // 32

5.114.s:
etasya ca gurutvaṃ ca prasādāttava padmaja ..
yathā bhavati deveśa tayā nītirvidhīyatām .. 33 ..
5.114.d:
एतस्य च गुरुत्वं च प्रसादात्तव पद्मज ..
यथा भवति देवेश तया नीतिर्विधीयताम् .. 33 ..
5.114.m: and so that by your favour, O lotus-born one, he may become a preceptor, / O Lord of gods, let such a rule be established.' // 33

5.114.s:
brahmā dadau tatastasya maṃtragrāmamanuttamam ..
yena vijñāyate sarvaṃ vedārtho yajñakarma ca .. 34 ..
5.114.d:
ब्रह्मा ददौ ततस्तस्य मंत्रग्राममनुत्तमम् ..
येन विज्ञायते सर्वं वेदार्थो यज्ञकर्म च .. 34 ..
5.114.m: Then Brahmā gave him the unsurpassed collection of mantras, / by which all the meaning of the Veda and sacrificial rituals are known. // 34

5.114.s:
tataḥ provāca tānsarvānprahaṣṭenātarātmanā ..
eṣa vedārthasaṃpanno bhaviṣyati mahāyaśāḥ .. 35 ..
bhartṛyajña iti khyāto yajñakarmavicakṣaṇaḥ ..
yadeva vakti yuṣmākaṃ kriyākāṃḍamaśaṃkitaiḥ .. 3 ..
5.114.d:
ततः प्रोवाच तान्सर्वान्प्रहष्टेनातरात्मना ..
एष वेदार्थसंपन्नो भविष्यति महायशाः .. 35 ..
भर्तृयज्ञ इति ख्यातो यज्ञकर्मविचक्षणः ..
यदेव वक्ति युष्माकं क्रियाकांडमशंकितैः .. 3 ..
5.114.m:
Then he said to them all, with his inner self deeply delighted: / 'This renowned one will be endowed with the meaning of the Veda. // 35
Known as Bhartṛyajña, skilled in sacrificial rituals, / whatever division of rituals he tells you, unhesitatingly, // 36

5.114.s:
tatkāryaṃ svargamokṣāya mama vākyātprabodhitaiḥ ..
vedārthāneṣa sarveṣāṃ yuṣmākaṃ yojayiṣyati .. 37 ..
5.114.d:
तत्कार्यं स्वर्गमोक्षाय मम वाक्यात्प्रबोधितैः ..
वेदार्थानेष सर्वेषां युष्माकं योजयिष्यति .. 37 ..
5.114.m: that must be done for heaven and liberation, enlightened by my word. / He will adapt the meanings of the Veda for all of you. // 37

5.114.s:
ye cānyeṣu ca deśeṣu sthāneṣu ca gatāḥ kvacit ..
etatsthānaṃ parityajya satyametadvijottamāḥ .. 38 ..
5.114.d:
ये चान्येषु च देशेषु स्थानेषु च गताः क्वचित् ..
एतत्स्थानं परित्यज्य सत्यमेतद्विजोत्तमाः .. 38 ..
5.114.m: And for those who went to other countries and places anywhere, / having left this place—this is the truth, O best of brahmins. // 38

5.114.s:
vedasthāne ca buddhyaiṣa yatkarma pracariṣyati ..
nānṛte vātha pāpe ca vāṇī cāsya cariṣyati .. 39 ..
5.114.d:
वेदस्थाने च बुद्ध्यैष यत्कर्म प्रचरिष्यति ..
नानृते वाथ पापे च वाणी चास्य चरिष्यति .. 39 ..
5.114.m: Whatever rite he performs through understanding of the seat of the Veda, / his speech will never proceed into falsehood or sin.' // 39

5.114.s:
evamuktvā sa deveśo virarāma pitāmahaḥ ..
bhartṛyajño'pi tāḥ sarvāścakre yajñakriyāḥ śubhāḥ .. 6.115.40 ..
5.114.d:
एवमुक्त्वा स देवेशो विरराम पितामहः ..
भर्तृयज्ञोऽपि ताः सर्वाश्चक्रे यज्ञक्रियाः शुभाः .. 6.115.40 ..
5.114.m: Having spoken thus, the Lord of gods, the Grandfather, fell silent. / Bhartṛyajña too performed all those auspicious sacrificial rituals, // 40

5.114.s:
brāhmaṇānāṃ hitārthāya śrutyarthaṃ tasya kevalam ..
daśapramāṇāḥ saṃproktāḥ sarve te brāhmaṇottamāḥ .. 41 ..
5.114.d:
ब्राह्मणानां हितार्थाय श्रुत्यर्थं तस्य केवलम् ..
दशप्रमाणाः संप्रोक्ताः सर्वे ते ब्राह्मणोत्तमाः .. 41 ..
5.114.m: for the welfare of the brahmins, solely for the meaning of revelation. / All those foremost brahmins are proclaimed to be of ten authorities. // 41

5.114.s:
catuḥṣaṣṭiṣu gotreṣu hyevaṃ te brāhmaṇottamāḥ ..
tena tatra samānītāstrijātena mahātmanā .. 42 ..
5.114.d:
चतुःषष्टिषु गोत्रेषु ह्येवं ते ब्राह्मणोत्तमाः ..
तेन तत्र समानीतास्त्रिजातेन महात्मना .. 42 ..
5.114.m: Thus in sixty-four lineages, those foremost brahmins / were brought together there by that great-souled trijāta. // 42

5.114.s:
teṣāmekatra jātāni daśapaṃcaśatāni ca ..
sāmānya bhogamokṣāṇi tāni tena kṛtāni ca .. 43 ..
5.114.d:
तेषामेकत्र जातानि दशपंचशतानि च ..
सामान्य भोगमोक्षाणि तानि तेन कृतानि च .. 43 ..
5.114.m: There arose fifteen hundred [brahmins] united together, / and common enjoyment and liberation were established for them by him. // 43

5.114.s:
aṣṭaṣaṣṭivibhāgena pūrvamāyuvyayodbhavam ..
tatrāsīdatha gotre ca puruṣāṇāṃ prasaṃkhyayā .. 44 ..
5.114.d:
अष्टषष्टिविभागेन पूर्वमायुव्ययोद्भवम् ..
तत्रासीदथ गोत्रे च पुरुषाणां प्रसंख्यया .. 44 ..
5.114.m: By a division of sixty-eight, there previously was the expenditure of lifespan; / there, and in the lineage, according to the count of men, // 44

5.114.s:
tataḥ prabhṛti sarveṣāṃ sāmānyena vyavasthitam ..
trijātasya ca vākyena yena dūrādapi drutam .. 45 ..
5.114.d:
ततः प्रभृति सर्वेषां सामान्येन व्यवस्थितम् ..
त्रिजातस्य च वाक्येन येन दूरादपि द्रुतम् .. 45 ..
5.114.m: from that time forth, it was established in common for all, / by the word of the trijāta, through which [they came] swiftly even from afar. // 45

5.114.s:
samāgacchaṃti viprendrāḥ puravṛddhiḥ prajāyate ..
na kaścidyāti saṃtyaktvā dausthyādanyatra ca dvijāḥ .. 46 ..
5.114.d:
समागच्छंति विप्रेन्द्राः पुरवृद्धिः प्रजायते ..
न कश्चिद्याति संत्यक्त्वा दौस्थ्यादन्यत्र च द्विजाः .. 46 ..
5.114.m: Eminent brahmins arrive and the city grows. / Nor does anyone abandon it to go elsewhere out of distress, O twice-born.

5.114.s:
tatasteṣāṃ sutaiḥ pautrairnaptṛbhiśca sahasraśaḥ ..
dauhitrairbhāgineyaiśca bhūyo bhūri prapūritam .. .. 47 ..
5.114.d:
ततस्तेषां सुतैः पौत्रैर्नप्तृभिश्च सहस्रशः ..
दौहित्रैर्भागिनेयैश्च भूयो भूरि प्रपूरितम् .. .. 47 ..
5.114.m: Then it was abundantly filled again by their sons, grandsons, and great-grandsons in the thousands, / and by daughters' sons and sisters' sons.

5.114.s:
tatpuraṃ vṛddhimāyāti dūrvāṃkurairiva dvijāḥ ..
kāṃḍātkāṃḍātprarohadbhiḥ saṃkhyāhīnairanekadhā .. 48 ..
5.114.d:
तत्पुरं वृद्धिमायाति दूर्वांकुरैरिव द्विजाः ..
कांडात्कांडात्प्ररोहद्भिः संख्याहीनैरनेकधा .. 48 ..
5.114.m: That city keeps expanding, O twice-born, like shoots of dūrvā grass / sprouting node by node in countless ways.

5.114.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
etadvaḥ sarvamākhyātaṃ gotrasaṃkhyānakaṃ śubham ..
ṛṣīṇāṃ kīrtanaṃ cāpi sarvapātakanāśanam .. 49 ..
5.114.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
एतद्वः सर्वमाख्यातं गोत्रसंख्यानकं शुभम् ..
ऋषीणां कीर्तनं चापि सर्वपातकनाशनम् .. 49 ..
5.114.m: Sūta said: / All this auspicious enumeration of gotras has been told to you, / as well as the recitation of the seers, which destroys all sins.

5.114.s:
yaścaitatpaṭhate nityaṃ śṛṇuyādvā prabhaktitaḥ ..
na syāttasya kulacchedaḥ kadācidapi bhūtale .. 6.115.50 ..
5.114.d:
यश्चैतत्पठते नित्यं शृणुयाद्वा प्रभक्तितः ..
न स्यात्तस्य कुलच्छेदः कदाचिदपि भूतले .. 6.115.50 ..
5.114.m: Whoever constantly recites or hears this with great devotion / shall never suffer the extinction of his lineage on this earth.

5.114.s:
tathā vimucyate pāpairājanmamaraṇodbhavaiḥ ..
na paśyati viyogaṃ ca kadācitpriyasaṃbhavam .. 51 ..
5.114.d:
तथा विमुच्यते पापैराजन्ममरणोद्भवैः ..
न पश्यति वियोगं च कदाचित्प्रियसंभवम् .. 51 ..
5.114.m: Likewise, he is freed from the sins born of life and death, / and he never witnesses separation from a loved one.

5.114.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye'ṣṭaṣaṣṭitīrthopākhyāne bhartṛyajñakṛtayajñavidhānamunigotravarṇanaṃnāma paṃcadaśottaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 115 .. .. cha ..
5.114.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्येऽष्टषष्टितीर्थोपाख्याने भर्तृयज्ञकृतयज्ञविधानमुनिगोत्रवर्णनंनाम पंचदशोत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 115 .. .. छ ..
5.114.m: Thus ends the one hundred and fifteenth chapter, titled "The Description of the Seers' Gotras and the Procedure of the Sacrifice Performed by Bhartṛyajña," in the Story of the Sixty-Eight Sacred Fords, within the Māhātmya of the Hāṭakeśvara Kṣetra, in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [section] of the eighty-one-thousand-verse collection of the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa.

5.115.s:
.. .. sūtauvāca .. ..
tathānyāpi ca tatrāsti suvikhyātāmbarevatī ..
devī kāmapradā puṃsāṃ bālakānāṃ sukhapradā .. 1 ..
5.115.d:
.. .. सूतौवाच .. ..
तथान्यापि च तत्रास्ति सुविख्याताम्बरेवती ..
देवी कामप्रदा पुंसां बालकानां सुखप्रदा .. 1 ..
5.115.m: Sūta said: / Likewise, there is another goddess there, well-renowned as Ambārevatī, / who grants desires to men and brings happiness to children.

5.115.s:
yāṃ dṛṣṭvā pūjayitvā'tha caitrāṣṭamyāṃ viśeṣataḥ ..
śuklāyāṃ nāpnuyānmartyaḥ kuṭumbavyasanaṃ kvacit .. 2 ..
5.115.d:
यां दृष्ट्वा पूजयित्वाऽथ चैत्राष्टम्यां विशेषतः ..
शुक्लायां नाप्नुयान्मर्त्यः कुटुम्बव्यसनं क्वचित् .. 2 ..
5.115.m: Beholding her and then worshiping her, especially on the eighth day / of the bright fortnight of Caitra, a mortal will never experience family disaster anywhere.

5.115.s:
.. .. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
kena vā sthāpitā tatra sā devī cāmbarevatī ..
kiṃprabhāvā kiṃsvarūpā sūtaputra vadasva naḥ .. 3 ..
5.115.d:
.. .. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
केन वा स्थापिता तत्र सा देवी चाम्बरेवती ..
किंप्रभावा किंस्वरूपा सूतपुत्र वदस्व नः .. 3 ..
5.115.m: The seers said: / By whom was that goddess Ambārevatī installed there? / Of what power is she, and of what form? Tell us, O Sūta's son!

5.115.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
yadā śeṣeṇa saṃdiṣṭā nānānāgā viṣolbaṇāḥ ..
purasyāsya vināśāya krodhasaṃraktalocanāḥ ..
tadā tasya priyā sā ca putraśokenapīḍitā .. 4 ..
5.115.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
यदा शेषेण संदिष्टा नानानागा विषोल्बणाः ..
पुरस्यास्य विनाशाय क्रोधसंरक्तलोचनाः ..
तदा तस्य प्रिया सा च पुत्रशोकेनपीडिता .. 4 ..
5.115.m: Sūta said: / When various nāgas fierce with venom and with eyes blood-red from rage / were ordered by Śeṣa to destroy that city, / then his beloved wife, tormented by grief for her son,

5.115.s:
svayamevāgrato gatvā bhakṣayāmāsa taṃ dvijam ..
kuṭumbena samāyuktaṃ yena putro nipātitaḥ .. 5 ..
5.115.d:
स्वयमेवाग्रतो गत्वा भक्षयामास तं द्विजम् ..
कुटुम्बेन समायुक्तं येन पुत्रो निपातितः .. 5 ..
5.115.m: went ahead by herself and devoured that twice-born / along with his family, by whom her son had been killed.

5.115.s:
atha tasya dvijendrasya bālavaidhavyasaṃyutā ..
anujā''sīttapoyuktā brahmacaryakṛtakṣaṇā .. 6 ..
5.115.d:
अथ तस्य द्विजेन्द्रस्य बालवैधव्यसंयुता ..
अनुजा'ऽसीत्तपोयुक्ता ब्रह्मचर्यकृतक्षणा .. 6 ..
5.115.m: Now that eminent twice-born had a younger sister afflicted by early widowhood, / endowed with austerity and devoted to celibacy.

5.115.s:
sā dṛṣṭvā bhakṣitaṃ sarvaṃ bhaṭṭikākhyā kuṭumbakam ..
nāga patnyā tataḥ prāha jalamādāya pāṇinā .. 7 ..
5.115.d:
सा दृष्ट्वा भक्षितं सर्वं भट्टिकाख्या कुटुम्बकम् ..
नाग पत्न्या ततः प्राह जलमादाय पाणिना .. 7 ..
5.115.m: Seeing her whole family devoured by the nāga's wife, / she, named Bhaṭṭikā, took water in her hand and said:

5.115.s:
yasmāttvayā kuṭumbaṃ me nāśaṃ nītaṃ dvijihvake ..
darśitaṃ ca mahadduḥkhaṃ mama bandhujanodbhavam .. 8 ..
5.115.d:
यस्मात्त्वया कुटुम्बं मे नाशं नीतं द्विजिह्वके ..
दर्शितं च महद्दुःखं मम बन्धुजनोद्भवम् .. 8 ..
5.115.m: "Because my family has been brought to ruin by you, O double-tongued one, / and great suffering arising from my kin has been shown to me,

5.115.s:
tathā tvamapi saṃprāpya mānuṣatvaṃ sugarhitam ..
mānuṣaṃ patimāsādya putrapautrānavāpya ca .. 9 ..
5.115.d:
तथा त्वमपि संप्राप्य मानुषत्वं सुगर्हितम् ..
मानुषं पतिमासाद्य पुत्रपौत्रानवाप्य च .. 9 ..
5.115.m: so you too, attaining the utterly despised human state, / obtaining a human husband and acquiring sons and grandsons,

5.115.s:
teṣāṃ vināśajaṃ duḥkhaṃ mā nuṣe tvamavāpsyasi ..
nāgatve vartamānāyāḥ śāpaṃ te'muṃ dadāmyaham .. 6.116.10 ..
5.115.d:
तेषां विनाशजं दुःखं मा नुषे त्वमवाप्स्यसि ..
नागत्वे वर्तमानायाः शापं तेऽमुं ददाम्यहम् .. 6.116.10 ..
5.115.m: shall experience in human form the sorrow born of their destruction! / To you who are now in the condition of a serpent, I pronounce this curse!"

5.115.s:
sā'pi śrutvā'tha taṃ śāpaṃ revatī bhaṭṭikodbhavam ..
krodhena mahatāviṣṭā hyadaśattāṃ drutaṃ tataḥ .. 11 ..
5.115.d:
साऽपि श्रुत्वाऽथ तं शापं रेवती भट्टिकोद्भवम् ..
क्रोधेन महताविष्टा ह्यदशत्तां द्रुतं ततः .. 11 ..
5.115.m: Hearing that curse pronounced by Bhaṭṭikā, Revatī, / seized with great rage, immediately bit her then.

5.115.s:
atha tasyāstanuṃ prāpya nāgīdaṃṣṭrā viṣolbaṇā ..
jagāma śatadhā nāśaṃ bibhide na tvacaṃ kvacit .. 12 ..
5.115.d:
अथ तस्यास्तनुं प्राप्य नागीदंष्ट्रा विषोल्बणा ..
जगाम शतधा नाशं बिभिदे न त्वचं क्वचित् .. 12 ..
5.115.m: Then, striking her body, the serpent-wife's fang, fierce with poison, / shattered into a hundred pieces, and did not pierce her skin anywhere.

5.115.s:
tataḥ sā lajjayāviṣṭā svaraktaplāvitānanā ..
viṣaṇṇā niṣasādātha saṃniviṣṭā dharātale .. 13 ..
5.115.d:
ततः सा लज्जयाविष्टा स्वरक्तप्लावितानना ..
विषण्णा निषसादाथ संनिविष्टा धरातले .. 13 ..
5.115.m: Then, overwhelmed with shame, her face washed in her own blood, / dejected, she sat down, settling upon the ground.

5.115.s:
etasminnaṃtare nāgāstathānye ye samāgatāḥ ..
revatīṃ te samālokya tathārūpāṃ bhayānvitām ..
procuśca kimidaṃ devi tava vaktre rujāspadam .. 14 ..
5.115.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे नागास्तथान्ये ये समागताः ..
रेवतीं ते समालोक्य तथारूपां भयान्विताम् ..
प्रोचुश्च किमिदं देवि तव वक्त्रे रुजास्पदम् .. 14 ..
5.115.m: Meanwhile, the other nāgas who had arrived, / beholding Revatī in such a state, stricken with fear, / said: "What is this seat of pain on your mouth, O lady?

5.115.s: athavā kiṃ prabhāvo'yaṃ kasyacidraktasaṃpadaḥ .. 15 ..
5.115.d: अथवा किं प्रभावोऽयं कस्यचिद्रक्तसंपदः .. 15 ..
5.115.m: Or whose blood is this rich effusion the effect of?"

5.115.s:
.. .. revatyuvāca .. ..
yeyaṃ duṣṭatamā kāciddṛśyate duṣṭatāpasī ..
asyā jāto vikāro'yaṃ mamāsye nāgasattamāḥ .. 16 ..
5.115.d:
.. .. रेवत्युवाच .. ..
येयं दुष्टतमा काचिद्दृश्यते दुष्टतापसी ..
अस्या जातो विकारोऽयं ममास्ये नागसत्तमाः .. 16 ..
5.115.m: Revatī said: / "This most wicked female ascetic who is seen here— / from her this affliction has arisen in my mouth, O best of serpents!

5.115.s:
tasmādenāṃ mahā duṣṭāṃ bhaginīṃ tasya durmateḥ ..
yena me nihataḥ putro dvijaputreṇa sāṃpratam .. 17 ..
5.115.d:
तस्मादेनां महा दुष्टां भगिनीं तस्य दुर्मतेः ..
येन मे निहतः पुत्रो द्विजपुत्रेण सांप्रतम् .. 17 ..
5.115.m: Therefore, this most wicked sister of that foolish / twice-born's son by whom my son was just slain,

5.115.s:
bhakṣyatāṃ bhakṣyatāṃ śīghraṃ mama nāśāya saṃsthitām ..
sāṃprataṃ manmukhe tenaṃ rudhiraṃ pannagottamāḥ .. 18 ..
5.115.d:
भक्ष्यतां भक्ष्यतां शीघ्रं मम नाशाय संस्थिताम् ..
सांप्रतं मन्मुखे तेनं रुधिरं पन्नगोत्तमाः .. 18 ..
5.115.m: devour her! Devour her quickly, who stands here for my destruction! / The blood now in my mouth is on her account, O best of serpents!"

5.115.s:
atha te pannagāḥ kruddhā dadaṃśustāṃ tapasvinīm ..
samaṃ sarveṣu gātreṣu yathānyā prākṛtā striyam .. 19 ..
5.115.d:
अथ ते पन्नगाः क्रुद्धा ददंशुस्तां तपस्विनीम् ..
समं सर्वेषु गात्रेषु यथान्या प्राकृता स्त्रियम् .. 19 ..
5.115.m: Then those enraged serpents bit that ascetic woman / equally on all her limbs, as if she were some ordinary woman.

5.115.s:
tatasteṣāmapi tathā mukhāddaṃṣṭrā vinirgatāḥ ..
rudhiraṃ ca tato jajñe śeṣapatnyā yathā tathā .. 6.116.20 ..
5.115.d:
ततस्तेषामपि तथा मुखाद्दंष्ट्रा विनिर्गताः ..
रुधिरं च ततो जज्ञे शेषपत्न्या यथा तथा .. 6.116.20 ..
5.115.m: Then their fangs also broke forth from their mouths, / and blood emerged from them just as it did for Śeṣa's wife.

5.115.s:
atha tasyāḥ prabhāvaṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvā te nāgasattamāḥ ..
śeṣā bhaya paritrastāḥ prajagmuśca diśo daśa .. 21 ..
5.115.d:
अथ तस्याः प्रभावं तं दृष्ट्वा ते नागसत्तमाः ..
शेषा भय परित्रस्ताः प्रजग्मुश्च दिशो दश .. 21 ..
5.115.m: Then, seeing her power, those remaining foremost serpents / fled in terror in the ten directions.

5.115.s:
bhaṭṭikāpi jagāmāśu svāśramaṃ prati duḥkhitā ..
bhayatrastaiḥ samaṃtācca vīkṣyamāṇā mahoragaiḥ .. 22 ..
5.115.d:
भट्टिकापि जगामाशु स्वाश्रमं प्रति दुःखिता ..
भयत्रस्तैः समंताच्च वीक्ष्यमाणा महोरगैः .. 22 ..
5.115.m: Bhaṭṭikā too went quickly toward her own hermitage, grieving, / watched on all sides by the great serpents who were frightened with fear.

5.115.s:
tataḥ sarvaṃ samālokya tāpyamānaṃ mahoragaiḥ..
tatsthānaṃ svajanairmuktaṃ duḥkhena mahatānvitaiḥ .. 23 .
5.115.d:
ततः सर्वं समालोक्य ताप्यमानं महोरगैः..
तत्स्थानं स्वजनैर्मुक्तं दुःखेन महतान्वितैः .. 23 .
5.115.m: Then, seeing everything being tormented by the great serpents, / that place was abandoned by their relatives, who were filled with great sorrow.

5.115.s:
jagāmānyatra sā sādhvī samyagvrataparāyaṇā ..
tīrtha yātrāṃ prakurvāṇā paribabhrāma medinīm .. 24 ..
5.115.d:
जगामान्यत्र सा साध्वी सम्यग्व्रतपरायणा ..
तीर्थ यात्रां प्रकुर्वाणा परिबभ्राम मेदिनीम् .. 24 ..
5.115.m: That virtuous woman, fully intent on her vows, went elsewhere; / performing a pilgrimage to sacred fords, she wandered the earth.

5.115.s:
evamudvāsite sthāne tasminsā revatī tadā ..
smṛtvā taṃ bhaṭṭikāśāpaṃ duḥkhena mahatā'nvitā .. 25 ..
5.115.d:
एवमुद्वासिते स्थाने तस्मिन्सा रेवती तदा ..
स्मृत्वा तं भट्टिकाशापं दुःखेन महताऽन्विता .. 25 ..
5.115.m: When that place was thus abandoned, Revatī then, / remembering Bhaṭṭikā's curse, was seized with great sorrow:

5.115.s:
kathaṃ me mānuṣīgarbhe śāpādvāso bhaviṣyati ..
mānuṣyeṇa ca kāṃtena prabhaviṣyati saṃgamaḥ .. 26 ..
5.115.d:
कथं मे मानुषीगर्भे शापाद्वासो भविष्यति ..
मानुष्येण च कांतेन प्रभविष्यति संगमः .. 26 ..
5.115.m: "How will dwelling in a human womb come about for me through this curse, / and union with a human husband happen?

5.115.s:
naitatputrodbhavaṃ duḥkhaṃ tathā māṃ bādhate hradi ..
yathedaṃ mānuṣe garbhe saṃvāso mānuṣaṃ prati .. 27 ..
5.115.d:
नैतत्पुत्रोद्भवं दुःखं तथा मां बाधते ह्रदि ..
यथेदं मानुषे गर्भे संवासो मानुषं प्रति .. 27 ..
5.115.m: This grief arising for my son does not torment me in my heart / as much as this dwelling in a human womb and facing a human [husband]!

5.115.s:
tathā daśanasaṃtyaktā kathaṃ bhartuḥ svamānanam ..
darśayiṣyāmi bhūyo'pi kṣate kṣāro'tra me sthitaḥ .. 28 ..
5.115.d:
तथा दशनसंत्यक्ता कथं भर्तुः स्वमाननम् ..
दर्शयिष्यामि भूयोऽपि क्षते क्षारोऽत्र मे स्थितः .. 28 ..
5.115.m: Moreover, deprived of my teeth, how shall I show my face / to my husband again? Here salt has been rubbed into my wound!

5.115.s:
tasmātparicariṣyāmi kṣetre'traiva vyavasthitā .
kiṃ kariṣyāmi saṃprāpya gṛhaṃ putraṃ vinākṛtā .. 29 ..
5.115.d:
तस्मात्परिचरिष्यामि क्षेत्रेऽत्रैव व्यवस्थिता .
किं करिष्यामि संप्राप्य गृहं पुत्रं विनाकृता .. 29 ..
5.115.m: Therefore, remaining right here in this sacred field, I shall worship. / What will I do upon reaching home, deprived of my son?"

5.115.s:
tataścārādhayāmāsa samyakchraddhāsamanvitā ..
aṃbikāṃ sā tadā devīṃ sthāpayitvā sureśvarīm .. 6.116.30 ..
5.115.d:
ततश्चाराधयामास सम्यक्छ्रद्धासमन्विता ..
अंबिकां सा तदा देवीं स्थापयित्वा सुरेश्वरीम् .. 6.116.30 ..
5.115.m: Then, endowed with full faith, she installed the goddess Ambikā, / sovereign of the gods, and worshiped her

5.115.s:
gandhapuṣpopahāreṇa naivedyairvividhairapi ..
gītanṛtyaistathā vādyairmanohāribhireva ca .. 31 ..
5.115.d:
गन्धपुष्पोपहारेण नैवेद्यैर्विविधैरपि ..
गीतनृत्यैस्तथा वाद्यैर्मनोहारिभिरेव च .. 31 ..
5.115.m: with offerings of incense, flowers, and various kinds of food offerings, / as well as charming songs, dances, and musical instruments.

5.115.s:
tataḥ katipayāhasya tastāstuṣṭā sureśvarī ..
provāca varadā'smīti prārthayasva hṛdi sthitam .. 32 ..
5.115.d:
ततः कतिपयाहस्य तस्तास्तुष्टा सुरेश्वरी ..
प्रोवाच वरदाऽस्मीति प्रार्थयस्व हृदि स्थितम् .. 32 ..
5.115.m: Then, after a few days, the sovereign of the gods, pleased with her, / said: "I am the granter of boons; ask for what is in your heart."

5.115.s:
.. revatyuvāca .. ..
ahaṃ śaptā purā devi brāhmaṇyā kāraṇāṃtare ..
yattvaṃ mānuṣamāsādya svayaṃ bhūtvā ca mānuṣī .. 33 ..
5.115.d:
.. रेवत्युवाच .. ..
अहं शप्ता पुरा देवि ब्राह्मण्या कारणांतरे ..
यत्त्वं मानुषमासाद्य स्वयं भूत्वा च मानुषी .. 33 ..
5.115.m: Revatī said: / "Formerly, O goddess, I was cursed by a brahmin woman on another occasion: / 'Becoming a human woman yourself and obtaining a human [husband],

5.115.s:
tataḥ saṃprāpsyasi phalaṃ teṣāṃ nāśasamudravam ..
mahadduḥkhaṃ svaputrotthaṃ mama śāpena pīḍitā .. 34 ..
5.115.d:
ततः संप्राप्स्यसि फलं तेषां नाशसमुद्रवम् ..
महद्दुःखं स्वपुत्रोत्थं मम शापेन पीडिता .. 34 ..
5.115.m: you shall then suffer the fruit arising from their destruction, / afflicted by the great sorrow born of your own sons through my curse.'

5.115.s:
tathā mama mukhāddaṃṣṭrā saṃnītāśca sureśvari ..
teṣāṃ ca saṃbhavastāvatkathaṃ syāttvatprabhāvataḥ .. 35 ..
5.115.d:
तथा मम मुखाद्दंष्ट्रा संनीताश्च सुरेश्वरि ..
तेषां च संभवस्तावत्कथं स्यात्त्वत्प्रभावतः .. 35 ..
5.115.m: Likewise, the fangs have been drawn from my mouth, O ruler of the gods. / How, then, by your power, can their rebirth come to be?

5.115.s:
bhavaṃtu tanayā naśca tathā vaṃśavivardhanāḥ ..
etanme vāṃchitaṃ devi nānyatsaṃprārthayāmyaham .. 36 ..
5.115.d:
भवंतु तनया नश्च तथा वंशविवर्धनाः ..
एतन्मे वांछितं देवि नान्यत्संप्रार्थयाम्यहम् .. 36 ..
5.115.m: May we have sons who will carry on our lineage! / This is my desire, O goddess; I ask for nothing else.

5.115.s:
.. devyuvāca.. .
nātra vāsastvayā kāryaḥ kathaṃcidapi śobhane ..
manuṣyagarbhasaṃvāso bharttā ca bhavitā naraḥ . 37 .
5.115.d:
.. देव्युवाच.. .
नात्र वासस्त्वया कार्यः कथंचिदपि शोभने ..
मनुष्यगर्भसंवासो भर्त्ता च भविता नरः . 37 .
5.115.m: The goddess said: / You must by no means dwell here, O lovely lady; / there shall be dwelling in a human womb, and your husband shall be a mortal man.

5.115.s:
tasmācchṛṇuṣva me vākyaṃ yattvāṃ vakṣyāmi sāṃpratam ..
duḥkhanāśakaraṃ tubhyaṃ satyaṃ ca varavarṇini .. .. 38 ..
5.115.d:
तस्माच्छृणुष्व मे वाक्यं यत्त्वां वक्ष्यामि सांप्रतम् ..
दुःखनाशकरं तुभ्यं सत्यं च वरवर्णिनि .. .. 38 ..
5.115.m: Therefore listen to my word which I shall speak to you now, / bringing destruction to your sorrow, and true, O fair-complexioned one.

5.115.s:
utpatsyati na saṃdeho devakāryaprasiddhaye ..
tava bharttā triloke'sminkṛtvā mānuṣavigraham .. 39 ..
takṣakākhyastathā nāgo dvijaśāpa vaśācchubhe ..
saurāṣṭraviṣaye rājā raivatākhyo bhaviṣyati ..6.116.4...
tasya kṣemakarī bhāryā nāmavaṃśasamudbhavā ..
bhaviṣyati na saṃdeho viśiṣṭā vipraśāpataḥ .. ..4...
5.115.d:
उत्पत्स्यति न संदेहो देवकार्यप्रसिद्धये ..
तव भर्त्ता त्रिलोकेऽस्मिन्कृत्वा मानुषविग्रहम् .. 39 ..
तक्षकाख्यस्तथा नागो द्विजशाप वशाच्छुभे ..
सौराष्ट्रविषये राजा रैवताख्यो भविष्यति ..6.116.4...
तस्य क्षेमकरी भार्या नामवंशसमुद्भवा ..
भविष्यति न संदेहो विशिष्टा विप्रशापतः .. ..4...
5.115.m:
For the accomplishment of the work of the gods, there is no doubt: / your husband will take a human form and be born in this threefold world.
Likewise, the serpent named Takṣaka, through the power of a twice-born's curse, O auspicious lady, / will become a king named Raivata in the Saurāṣṭra realm.
His wife will be Kṣemakarī, born of a distinguished family— / there is no doubt—eminent through a curse of a brahmin.

5.115.s:
tasyā garbhaṃ samāsādya tvaṃ janma samavāpsyasi ..
rāmarūpasya śeṣasya punarbhāryā bhaviṣyasi ..42..
5.115.d:
तस्या गर्भं समासाद्य त्वं जन्म समवाप्स्यसि ..
रामरूपस्य शेषस्य पुनर्भार्या भविष्यसि ..42..
5.115.m: Entering her womb, you will attain birth; / and you will once again become the wife of Śeṣa who will have the form of Rāma.

5.115.s:
tasmāttvaṃ devi mā śokaṃ kārye'sminkuru śobhane ..
tena mānuṣaje garbhe saṃbhūtiḥ saṃbhaviṣyati .. 43 ..
5.115.d:
तस्मात्त्वं देवि मा शोकं कार्येऽस्मिन्कुरु शोभने ..
तेन मानुषजे गर्भे संभूतिः संभविष्यति .. 43 ..
5.115.m: Therefore, O goddess, do not grieve over this matter, O fair one; / by that means your birth shall take place in a human womb.

5.115.s:
tatra paśyasi yannāśaṃ svakuṭumbasamudbhavam ..
hitāya tadavasthāyāstadbhaviṣyatyasaṃśayam .. 44 ..
5.115.d:
तत्र पश्यसि यन्नाशं स्वकुटुम्बसमुद्भवम् ..
हिताय तदवस्थायास्तद्भविष्यत्यसंशयम् .. 44 ..
5.115.m: The destruction that you will see there, arising among your own kin, / shall without doubt occur for the good of that condition.

5.115.s:
tataḥ paraṃ yugaṃ pāpaṃ yato bhīru bhaviṣyati ..
tadūrdhvaṃ martyadharmāṇo mlecchāḥ sthāsyaṃti sarvataḥ .. 45 ..
5.115.d:
ततः परं युगं पापं यतो भीरु भविष्यति ..
तदूर्ध्वं मर्त्यधर्माणो म्लेच्छाः स्थास्यंति सर्वतः .. 45 ..
5.115.m: For after that, O timid one, the sinful age will arrive; / thereafter barbarians, following mortal ways, will establish themselves everywhere.

5.115.s:
tataḥ svarganivāsārthaṃ bhagavāndevakīsutaḥ ..
saṃhartā svakulaṃ sarvaṃ svayameva na saṃśayaḥ .. 46 ..
5.115.d:
ततः स्वर्गनिवासार्थं भगवान्देवकीसुतः ..
संहर्ता स्वकुलं सर्वं स्वयमेव न संशयः .. 46 ..
5.115.m: Then, in order to return to his heavenly abode, the Lord, the son of Devakī, / will himself destroy his entire clan; there is no doubt.

5.115.s:
bhaviṣyaṃti punardaṃṣṭrāstava vaktre manoramāḥ ..
tasmāttvaṃ gaccha pātālaṃ svabharttā yatra tiṣṭhati .. 47 ..
5.115.d:
भविष्यंति पुनर्दंष्ट्रास्तव वक्त्रे मनोरमाः ..
तस्मात्त्वं गच्छ पातालं स्वभर्त्ता यत्र तिष्ठति .. 47 ..
5.115.m: The delightful fangs in your mouth will appear again; / therefore go to Pātāla, where your husband dwells.

5.115.s:
anyaccāpi yadiṣṭaṃ te kiṃciccitte vyavasthitam ..
tatkīrtayasva kalyāṇi mahāṃstoṣo mama sthitaḥ .. 48 .
5.115.d:
अन्यच्चापि यदिष्टं ते किंचिच्चित्ते व्यवस्थितम् ..
तत्कीर्तयस्व कल्याणि महांस्तोषो मम स्थितः .. 48 .
5.115.m: And whatever other desire is set within your heart, / declare that, O blessed lady; great satisfaction remains in me.

5.115.s:
.. revatyu vāca .. ..
sthāne stheyaṃ sadā'traiva mama nāmnā sureśvari ..
yena me jāyate kīrtistrailokye sacarācare ..49..
5.115.d:
.. रेवत्यु वाच .. ..
स्थाने स्थेयं सदाऽत्रैव मम नाम्ना सुरेश्वरि ..
येन मे जायते कीर्तिस्त्रैलोक्ये सचराचरे ..49..
5.115.m: Revatī said: / You must always dwell in this very place in my name, O ruler of the gods, / so that my fame may arise in the three worlds, both moving and unmoving.

5.115.s:
tathā'haṃ nāgalokācca caturdaśyaṣṭamīṣu ca ..
sadā tvāṃ pūjayiṣyāmi viśeṣānnavamīdine ..6.116.50...
5.115.d:
तथाऽहं नागलोकाच्च चतुर्दश्यष्टमीषु च ..
सदा त्वां पूजयिष्यामि विशेषान्नवमीदिने ..6.116.50...
5.115.m: And from the serpent world, on the fourteenth and eighth lunar days, / I will always worship you, especially on the ninth day.

5.115.s:
āśvinasya site pakṣe sarvairnāgaiḥ samanvitā ..
prapūjāṃ te vidhāsyāmi śraddhayā parayā yutā ..51..
5.115.d:
आश्विनस्य सिते पक्षे सर्वैर्नागैः समन्विता ..
प्रपूजां ते विधास्यामि श्रद्धया परया युता ..51..
5.115.m: In the bright fortnight of Āśvina, accompanied by all the serpents, / I will perform your worship endowed with supreme faith.

5.115.s:
tasminnahani ye'nye'pi pūjāṃ dāsyaṃti te narāḥ ..
mā paśyaṃtu prasādātte narāste vallabhakṣayam . 52 .
5.115.d:
तस्मिन्नहनि येऽन्येऽपि पूजां दास्यंति ते नराः ..
मा पश्यंतु प्रसादात्ते नरास्ते वल्लभक्षयम् . 52 .
5.115.m: On that day, whatever other men offer worship to you, / may those men, by your grace, never see the loss of their loved ones.

5.115.s:
.. devyuvāca .. ..
evaṃ bhadre kariṣyāmi vāso me'tra bhaviṣyati..
tvannāmnā pūjakānāṃ ca śreyo dāsyāmi te sadā ..
mahānavamije cāhni viśeṣeṇa śucismite .. 53 ..
5.115.d:
.. देव्युवाच .. ..
एवं भद्रे करिष्यामि वासो मेऽत्र भविष्यति..
त्वन्नाम्ना पूजकानां च श्रेयो दास्यामि ते सदा ..
महानवमिजे चाह्नि विशेषेण शुचिस्मिते .. 53 ..
5.115.m: The goddess said: / So I will do, gentle lady; my dwelling shall be here. / In your name I will always bestow welfare upon your worshippers, / especially on the day born of Mahānavamī, O lady of radiant smile.

5.115.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
evamuktā tayā sā'tha revatī śeṣavallabhā ..
jagāma svagṛhaṃ paścāddharṣeṇa mahatānvitā 54 ..
5.115.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
एवमुक्ता तया साऽथ रेवती शेषवल्लभा ..
जगाम स्वगृहं पश्चाद्धर्षेण महतान्विता 54 ..
5.115.m: Sūta said: / Thus addressed by her, Revatī, beloved of Śeṣa, / then went to her own home filled with great joy.

5.115.s:
tataḥprabhṛti sā devī tasminkṣetre vyavasthitā ..
tannāmnā kāmadā nṛṇāṃ sarvavyasananāśinī .. 55 ..
5.115.d:
ततःप्रभृति सा देवी तस्मिन्क्षेत्रे व्यवस्थिता ..
तन्नाम्ना कामदा नृणां सर्वव्यसननाशिनी .. 55 ..
5.115.m: From that time forward, that goddess remained in that sacred field, / fulfilling men's desires and destroying all distress under that name.

5.115.s:
aṃbā sā kīrtyate durgā revatī soragapriyā ..
tataḥ saṃkīrtyate loke bhūtale cāṃbarevatī .. 56 ..
5.115.d:
अंबा सा कीर्त्यते दुर्गा रेवती सोरगप्रिया ..
ततः संकीर्त्यते लोके भूतले चांबरेवती .. 56 ..
5.115.m: She is celebrated as Ambā, as Durgā, and as Revatī, dear to the serpents; / therefore she is proclaimed on the earth and in the world as Ambārevatī.

5.115.s:
yastāṃ śraddhāsamopetaḥ śucirbhūtvā prapūjayet ..
navamyāmāśvine māsi śuklapakṣe samāhitaḥ ..
na sa saṃvatsaraṃ yāvadvyasanaṃ svakulo dbhavam.. 57..
5.115.d:
यस्तां श्रद्धासमोपेतः शुचिर्भूत्वा प्रपूजयेत् ..
नवम्यामाश्विने मासि शुक्लपक्षे समाहितः ..
न स संवत्सरं यावद्व्यसनं स्वकुलो द्भवम्.. 57..
5.115.m: Whoever, endowed with faith, becomes pure and worships her / with concentrated mind on the ninth day of the bright fortnight in the month of Āśvina, / for the space of a year does not [experience] distress arising in his own clan.

5.115.s:
dṛṣṭvāgre chidrakaṃ vyālayuktaṃ doṣairvimucyate ..
grahabhūtapiśācotthaistathānyairapi cāpadaiḥ .. 58 ..
5.115.d:
दृष्ट्वाग्रे छिद्रकं व्यालयुक्तं दोषैर्विमुच्यते ..
ग्रहभूतपिशाचोत्थैस्तथान्यैरपि चापदैः .. 58 ..
5.115.m: Having beheld the opening inhabited by the serpent in front, he is freed from faults, / from those arising from planets, spirits, and piśācas, as well as from other afflictions.

5.115.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhahasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmyeṃ'bārevatītīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣoḍaśottaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. .. 116 .. .. cha ..
5.115.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्येंऽबारेवतीतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम षोडशोत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. .. 116 .. .. छ ..
5.115.m: Thus ends the one hundred and sixteenth chapter, named 'Description of the Glory of the Ambārevatī Sacred Ford,' in the glorification of the Hāṭakeśvara sacred field, in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [section], in the Mahāpurāṇa of Skanda consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

5.116.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
bhaṭṭikākhyā purā proktā yā tvayā sūtanandana ..
kasmāttasyāḥ śarīrāntāddaṃṣṭrā nāgasamudbhavāḥ .. 1 ..
5.116.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
भट्टिकाख्या पुरा प्रोक्ता या त्वया सूतनन्दन ..
कस्मात्तस्याः शरीरान्ताद्दंष्ट्रा नागसमुद्भवाः .. 1 ..
5.116.m: The seers said: / She who was called Bhaṭṭikā of old by you, O son of Sūta— / why were the fangs originating from the serpent shattered from her body?

5.116.s:
viśīrṇāḥ kiṃ prabhāvaśca tapasaḥ sūtanandana ..
kiṃ vā maṃtraprabhāvaśca etannaḥ kautukaṃ param .. 2 ..
5.116.d:
विशीर्णाः किं प्रभावश्च तपसः सूतनन्दन ..
किं वा मंत्रप्रभावश्च एतन्नः कौतुकं परम् .. 2 ..
5.116.m: Was it the power of austerity, O son of Sūta, / or the power of mantra? This is our greatest wonder!

5.116.s:
yanmānuṣaśarīre'pi viśīrṇāstā viṣolbaṇāḥ ..
nāgānāṃ tu viśeṣeṇa tasmātsarvaṃ prakīrtaya .. 3 ..
5.116.d:
यन्मानुषशरीरेऽपि विशीर्णास्ता विषोल्बणाः ..
नागानां तु विशेषेण तस्मात्सर्वं प्रकीर्तय .. 3 ..
5.116.m: That even in a human body those [fangs] fierce with venom were shattered, / especially those of the serpents—therefore recount it all!

5.116.s:
. sūta uvāca .. ..
sā purā brāhmaṇī bālye vartamānā piturgṛhe ..
vaidhavyena samāyuktā jātā karmavipākataḥ .. 4 ..
5.116.d:
. सूत उवाच .. ..
सा पुरा ब्राह्मणी बाल्ये वर्तमाना पितुर्गृहे ..
वैधव्येन समायुक्ता जाता कर्मविपाकतः .. 4 ..
5.116.m: Sūta said: / Formerly, in her childhood while dwelling in her father's house, / that brahmin woman was afflicted with widowhood through the ripening of past actions.

5.116.s:
tato bālye'pi śuśrāva śāstrāṇi vividhāni ca ..
devayātrāṃ pracakre'tha tīrthe snāti samāhitā .. 5 ..
5.116.d:
ततो बाल्येऽपि शुश्राव शास्त्राणि विविधानि च ..
देवयात्रां प्रचक्रेऽथ तीर्थे स्नाति समाहिता .. 5 ..
5.116.m: Then, even in childhood, she listened to various sacred scriptures; / she undertook pilgrimages to deities and, composed in mind, bathed in the sacred ford.

5.116.s:
tatra kedāradevaṃ ca gatvā nityaṃ samāhitā ..
prātarutthāya gītaṃ ca bhaktyā cakre tadagrataḥ .. 6 ..
5.116.d:
तत्र केदारदेवं च गत्वा नित्यं समाहिता ..
प्रातरुत्थाय गीतं च भक्त्या चक्रे तदग्रतः .. 6 ..
5.116.m: Having gone there to the god Kedāra, always composed, / she rose in the morning and sang songs before him with devotion.

5.116.s:
tatastadgītalaulyena pātālātsamupetya ca ..
takṣako vāsukiścaiva dvija rūpadharāvubhau .. 7 ..
5.116.d:
ततस्तद्गीतलौल्येन पातालात्समुपेत्य च ..
तक्षको वासुकिश्चैव द्विज रूपधरावुभौ .. 7 ..
5.116.m: Then, drawn by their longing for that song, having come from Pātāla, / both Takṣaka and Vāsuki assumed the form of twice-born men.

5.116.s:
sā'pi tatra mahadgītaṃ tānaiḥ sarvairalaṃkṛtam..
mūrcchanābhiḥ samopetaṃ saptasvaravirājitam .. 8 ..
5.116.d:
साऽपि तत्र महद्गीतं तानैः सर्वैरलंकृतम्..
मूर्च्छनाभिः समोपेतं सप्तस्वरविराजितम् .. 8 ..
5.116.m: She sang a great song there, adorned with all melodic patterns, / endowed with modulations, and radiant with the seven notes,

5.116.s:
yatibhiśca tathā grāmairvarṇagrāmaiḥ pṛtha gvidhaiḥ..
tataṃ ca vitataṃ caiva ghanaṃ suṣirameva ca .. 9 ..
5.116.d:
यतिभिश्च तथा ग्रामैर्वर्णग्रामैः पृथ ग्विधैः..
ततं च विततं चैव घनं सुषिरमेव च .. 9 ..
5.116.m: with pauses, tone-scales, and various classes of melodic figures, / with stringed, covered, solid, and hollow [instruments],

5.116.s:
tālakālakriyāmānavardhamānādikaṃ ca yat ..
avidagdhāpi sā teṣāṃ gītāṃgānāṃ dvijāṃganā ..
kevalaṃ kaṃṭhasaṃśuddhyā tābhyāṃ toṣaṃ samādadhe ..6.117.10....
5.116.d:
तालकालक्रियामानवर्धमानादिकं च यत् ..
अविदग्धापि सा तेषां गीतांगानां द्विजांगना ..
केवलं कंठसंशुद्ध्या ताभ्यां तोषं समादधे ..6.117.10....
5.116.m: and with rhythm, tempo, action, measure, augmentations, and the like. / Though untaught in these elements of song, that brahmin woman / produced satisfaction in them purely through the purity of her throat.

5.116.s:
tatastadgītalobhena sarve tatpuravāsinaḥ ..
prātarutthāya kedāraṃ samāgacchaṃti kautukāt ......
kasya cittvatha kālasya nāgau tau svapuraṃ prati ..
ninyurbalātsamudyamya sarvalokasya paśyataḥ.. 12 ..
5.116.d:
ततस्तद्गीतलोभेन सर्वे तत्पुरवासिनः ..
प्रातरुत्थाय केदारं समागच्छंति कौतुकात् ......
कस्य चित्त्वथ कालस्य नागौ तौ स्वपुरं प्रति ..
निन्युर्बलात्समुद्यम्य सर्वलोकस्य पश्यतः.. 12 ..
5.116.m: Then, out of eagerness for her singing, all the inhabitants of that city / would rise in the morning and come to Kedāra out of curiosity. / But after some time, those two serpents, having raised her by force / in the sight of all the people, carried her off toward their own city.

5.116.s:
nāgarūpaṃ samādhāya raudraṃ janavibhīṣaṇam ..
bhogāgryeṇa ca saṃveṣṭya pātālatalamabhyayuḥ .. 13 ..
5.116.d:
नागरूपं समाधाय रौद्रं जनविभीषणम् ..
भोगाग्र्येण च संवेष्ट्य पातालतलमभ्ययुः .. 13 ..
5.116.m: Assuming their terrible serpent form that terrified people, / and wrapping her with the tip of their coils, they went down to the depths of Pātāla.

5.116.s:
atha tāṃ svagṛhaṃ nītvā procatuḥ kāmapīḍitau ..
bhavāvābhyāṃ viśālākṣi bhāryā dharmaparāyaṇā ..
etadarthaṃ samānītā tvaṃ pātāle mahītalāt .. 14 ..
5.116.d:
अथ तां स्वगृहं नीत्वा प्रोचतुः कामपीडितौ ..
भवावाभ्यां विशालाक्षि भार्या धर्मपरायणा ..
एतदर्थं समानीता त्वं पाताले महीतलात् .. 14 ..
5.116.m: Then, having brought her to their home, afflicted by desire, they said: / 'O large-eyed lady devoted to dharma, be a wife unto us both; / for this purpose you have been brought to Pātāla from the surface of the earth.'

5.116.s:
.. bhaṭṭikovāca .. ..
yattvaṃ takṣaka māṃ śāṃtāmanapekṣāṃ ratotsave ..
ānaiṣīrapahṛtyāśu brāhmaṇānvaya saṃbhavām .. 15 ..
5.116.d:
.. भट्टिकोवाच .. ..
यत्त्वं तक्षक मां शांतामनपेक्षां रतोत्सवे ..
आनैषीरपहृत्याशु ब्राह्मणान्वय संभवाम् .. 15 ..
5.116.m: Bhaṭṭikā said: / 'Because you, O Takṣaka, have swiftly abducted and brought me, / a peaceful woman born of a brahmin line who cares nothing for the pleasure of love—

5.116.s:
mānuṣaṃ rūpamāsthāya purā māṃ tvaṃ samāśritaḥ ..
kāmopahṛtacittātmā tasmānmartyo bhaviṣyasi .. 16 ..
5.116.d:
मानुषं रूपमास्थाय पुरा मां त्वं समाश्रितः ..
कामोपहृतचित्तात्मा तस्मान्मर्त्यो भविष्यसि .. 16 ..
5.116.m: "Assuming a human form, you formerly approached me, / your mind and heart afflicted by desire; therefore, you shall become a mortal! 16

5.116.s:
yadi māṃ tvaṃ durācāra dharṣayiṣyasi vīryataḥ ..
śatadhā tava mūrdhā'yaṃ sadya eva bhaviṣyati .. 17 ..
5.116.d:
यदि मां त्वं दुराचार धर्षयिष्यसि वीर्यतः ..
शतधा तव मूर्धाऽयं सद्य एव भविष्यति .. 17 ..
5.116.m: If by force you violate me, evil-doer, / this head of yours will immediately split into a hundred pieces!" 17

5.116.s:
taṃ śrutvā sumahāśāpaṃ tasyāḥ sa bhayavihvalaḥ ..
tataḥ prasādayāmāsa kṛtāṃjalipuṭaḥ sthitaḥ .. 18 ..
5.116.d:
तं श्रुत्वा सुमहाशापं तस्याः स भयविह्वलः ..
ततः प्रसादयामास कृतांजलिपुटः स्थितः .. 18 ..
5.116.m: Hearing that immense curse from her, he was overwhelmed with fear; / standing with folded hands, he then sought to appease her: 18

5.116.s:
mayā tvaṃ kāmasaktena samānītā sumohataḥ ..
tasmātkuru prasādaṃ me śāpasyāṃto yathā bhavet .. 19 ..
5.116.d:
मया त्वं कामसक्तेन समानीता सुमोहतः ..
तस्मात्कुरु प्रसादं मे शापस्यांतो यथा भवेत् .. 19 ..
5.116.m: "Bound by desire, I brought you here out of sheer delusion; / therefore, grant me favor so that my curse may have an end." 19

5.116.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
evaṃ prasāditā tena takṣakeṇa dvijātmajā ..
tataḥ provāca taṃ nāgaṃ bāṣpavyākulalocanā .. 6.117.20 ..
5.116.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
एवं प्रसादिता तेन तक्षकेण द्विजात्मजा ..
ततः प्रोवाच तं नागं बाष्पव्याकुललोचना .. 6.117.20 ..
5.116.m: Sūta said: / Being thus appeased by that Takṣaka, the brahmin's daughter, / her eyes overflowing with tears, then spoke to that nāga: 20

5.116.s:
yadi māṃ martyaloke tvaṃ bhūyo na yasi takṣaka ..
tatra śāpasya paryaṃtaṃ kariṣyāmi na saṃśayaḥ .. 21 ..
5.116.d:
यदि मां मर्त्यलोके त्वं भूयो न यसि तक्षक ..
तत्र शापस्य पर्यंतं करिष्यामि न संशयः .. 21 ..
5.116.m: "If you lead me back to the mortal world, Takṣaka, / there I shall bring an end to your curse; of this there is no doubt." 21

5.116.s:
etasminnaṃtare jñātvā mānuṣīṃ svagṛhāgatām ..
takṣakeṇa samānītāṃ kāmopahatace tasā .. 22 ..
5.116.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे ज्ञात्वा मानुषीं स्वगृहागताम् ..
तक्षकेण समानीतां कामोपहतचे तसा .. 22 ..
5.116.m: Meanwhile, learning that a human woman had arrived at their house, / brought by Takṣaka whose mind was afflicted by desire, 22

5.116.s:
tatastasya kalatrāṇi maherṣyāsaṃśritāni ca ..
tasyā nāśārthamājagmuḥ koparaktekṣaṇāni ca .. 23
5.116.d:
ततस्तस्य कलत्राणि महेर्ष्यासंश्रितानि च ..
तस्या नाशार्थमाजग्मुः कोपरक्तेक्षणानि च .. 23
5.116.m: his wives, filled with great jealousy, / came with eyes red with fury in order to destroy her. 23

5.116.s:
atha tāsāṃ parijñāya takṣakaḥ sa viceṣṭitam ..
vāñchañchāpasya paryaṃtaṃ tatpārśvādbhayasaṃyutaḥ ..24..
5.116.d:
अथ तासां परिज्ञाय तक्षकः स विचेष्टितम् ..
वाञ्छञ्छापस्य पर्यंतं तत्पार्श्वाद्भयसंयुतः ..24..
5.116.m: Then Takṣaka, perceiving their intention, / desiring an end to the curse and filled with fear for her safety, 24

5.116.s:
vajrāṃ nāmāsmaradvidyāṃ tasyā gātraṃ tatastayā ..
yojayāmāsa rakṣārthaṃ prāptā cātha bhujaṃgamī .. 25 ..
5.116.d:
वज्रां नामास्मरद्विद्यां तस्या गात्रं ततस्तया ..
योजयामास रक्षार्थं प्राप्ता चाथ भुजंगमी .. 25 ..
5.116.m: remembered the lore named Vajrā. Thereupon, to protect her, he invested / her body with it; and just then a female serpent arrived. 25

5.116.s:
adaśattāṃ tataḥ kruddhā brāhmaṇasya sutāṃ satīm..
sapatnīṃ manyamānoccaiḥ śīrṇadaṃṣṭrā vyajāyata .. 26 ..
5.116.d:
अदशत्तां ततः क्रुद्धा ब्राह्मणस्य सुतां सतीम्..
सपत्नीं मन्यमानोच्चैः शीर्णदंष्ट्रा व्यजायत .. 26 ..
5.116.m: Then, enraged, regarding her openly as a co-wife, she bit / the virtuous daughter of the brahmin, and her fangs were shattered! 26

5.116.s:
atha tāmapi sā kruddhā śaśāpa dvijasaṃbhavā ..
dṛṣṭvā sāpatnyajairbhāvairvartamānāṃ saherṣyayā .. 27 ..
5.116.d:
अथ तामपि सा क्रुद्धा शशाप द्विजसंभवा ..
दृष्ट्वा सापत्न्यजैर्भावैर्वर्तमानां सहेर्ष्यया .. 27 ..
5.116.m: Then the brahmin-born maiden, enraged at seeing her / acting out of feelings of rivalry and full of jealousy, cursed her as well: 27

5.116.s:
yasmāttvaṃ doṣahīnāṃ māṃ sadoṣāmiva manyase ..
tasmādbhava drutaṃ pāpe mānuṣī duḥkhabhāginī .. 28 ..
5.116.d:
यस्मात्त्वं दोषहीनां मां सदोषामिव मन्यसे ..
तस्माद्भव द्रुतं पापे मानुषी दुःखभागिनी .. 28 ..
5.116.m: "Because you regard me, who am blameless, as guilty, / therefore, wretched one, swiftly become a mortal woman, sharing in sorrow!" 28

5.116.s:
atha tāṃ saṃgṛhītvā sa takṣako nāgasattamaḥ ..
kedārāyatane tasminnardharātre mumoca ha .. 29 ..
5.116.d:
अथ तां संगृहीत्वा स तक्षको नागसत्तमः ..
केदारायतने तस्मिन्नर्धरात्रे मुमोच ह .. 29 ..
5.116.m: Then that Takṣaka, best among nāgas, taking her, / released her at midnight in that sanctuary of Kedāra. 29

5.116.s:
tataḥ provāca tāṃ devīṃ kṛtāṃ jalipuṭaḥ sthitaḥ ..
śāpāṃtaṃ kuru me sādhvi svagṛhaṃ yena yāmyaham .. 6.117.30 ..
5.116.d:
ततः प्रोवाच तां देवीं कृतां जलिपुटः स्थितः ..
शापांतं कुरु मे साध्वि स्वगृहं येन याम्यहम् .. 6.117.30 ..
5.116.m: Then, standing with folded hands, he said to that lady: / "Virtuous one, grant an end to my curse, so that I may go to my own home." 30

5.116.s:
.. bhaṭṭikovāca .. ..
saurāṣṭraviṣaye rājā tvaṃ bhaviṣyasi pannaga ..
bhūmau raivatako nāma bhogānāṃ bhājanaṃ sadā .. 31 ..
5.116.d:
.. भट्टिकोवाच .. ..
सौराष्ट्रविषये राजा त्वं भविष्यसि पन्नग ..
भूमौ रैवतको नाम भोगानां भाजनं सदा .. 31 ..
5.116.m: Bhaṭṭikā said: / "O serpent, you will become a king in the country of Saurāṣṭra / on earth, named Raivataka, an eternal vessel of worldly pleasures. 31

5.116.s:
tataścaiva tanuṃ tyaktvā kṣetreṣvāśramamadhyataḥ ..
saṃprāpsyasi nijaṃ sthānaṃ tatkṣetrasya prabhāvataḥ .. .. 32 ..
5.116.d:
ततश्चैव तनुं त्यक्त्वा क्षेत्रेष्वाश्रममध्यतः ..
संप्राप्स्यसि निजं स्थानं तत्क्षेत्रस्य प्रभावतः .. .. 32 ..
5.116.m: And then, casting off your body in the sacred fields amidst the hermitage, / you shall attain your own abode through the power of that sacred field." 32

5.116.s:
.. takṣaka uvāca .. ..
eṣā mama priyā kāṃtā tvayā śāpena yojitā ..
yā sā bhavatu me bhāryā mānuṣatve'pi vartite .. 33 ..
5.116.d:
.. तक्षक उवाच .. ..
एषा मम प्रिया कांता त्वया शापेन योजिता ..
या सा भवतु मे भार्या मानुषत्वेऽपि वर्तिते .. 33 ..
5.116.m: Takṣaka said: / "This beloved wife of mine has been visited with a curse by you; / let her be my wife even when human life has begun. 33

5.116.s:
eta tkuru prasādaṃ me dīnasya pariyācataḥ ..
mā'syā bhavatu cānyena puruṣeṇa samāgamaḥ .. 34 ..
5.116.d:
एत त्कुरु प्रसादं मे दीनस्य परियाचतः ..
माऽस्या भवतु चान्येन पुरुषेण समागमः .. 34 ..
5.116.m: Grant this favor to me, miserable and begging: / may she have no union with any other man." 34

5.116.s:
.. bhaṭṭikovāca .. ..
ānartādhipatereṣā bhavitrī duhitā śubhā..
tataḥ pāṇigrahaṃ prāpya bhāryā tava bhaviṣyati..35..
5.116.d:
.. भट्टिकोवाच .. ..
आनर्ताधिपतेरेषा भवित्री दुहिता शुभा..
ततः पाणिग्रहं प्राप्य भार्या तव भविष्यति..35..
5.116.m: Bhaṭṭikā said: / "She will become the auspicious daughter of the ruler of Ānarta; / then, having attained marriage, she will be your wife. 35

5.116.s:
kṣemaṃkarīti vikhyātā rūpayauvanaśālinī ..
tvayā sārdhaṃ bahūnbhogānbhuktvā'tha pṛthivītale..
paraloke punastvāṃ vai cānuyāsyati śobhanā .. 36..
5.116.d:
क्षेमंकरीति विख्याता रूपयौवनशालिनी ..
त्वया सार्धं बहून्भोगान्भुक्त्वाऽथ पृथिवीतले..
परलोके पुनस्त्वां वै चानुयास्यति शोभना .. 36..
5.116.m: Renowned as Kṣemaṃkarī, endowed with beauty and youth, / after enjoying many pleasures together with you on the surface of the earth, / the fair one will indeed follow you again to the other world." 36

5.116.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
evaṃ ca sa tayā proktaḥ kṣamyatāmiti sādaram ..
praṇipatya jagāmā'tha nijaṃ sthānaṃ praharṣitaḥ ..37..
5.116.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
एवं च स तया प्रोक्तः क्षम्यतामिति सादरम् ..
प्रणिपत्य जगामाऽथ निजं स्थानं प्रहर्षितः ..37..
5.116.m: Sūta said: / Being thus addressed by her, saying respectfully, "Forgive me," / he bowed down and then went to his own abode, delighted. 37

5.116.s:
sā'pi prāpte niśāśeṣe kedārasya puraḥ sthitā ..
punaścakre ca tadgītaṃ śrutisaukhyakaraṃ param..38..
5.116.d:
साऽपि प्राप्ते निशाशेषे केदारस्य पुरः स्थिता ..
पुनश्चक्रे च तद्गीतं श्रुतिसौख्यकरं परम्..38..
5.116.m: She too, when the end of the night arrived, stood before Kedāra / and sang that song again, supremely delightful to the ear. 38

5.116.s:
atha tasya samāyātāḥ kedārasya didṛkṣavaḥ..
punaḥ kedārabhaktyāḍhyā brāhmaṇāḥ śataśaḥ param ..39..
5.116.d:
अथ तस्य समायाताः केदारस्य दिदृक्षवः..
पुनः केदारभक्त्याढ्या ब्राह्मणाः शतशः परम् ..39..
5.116.m: Then hundreds of brahmins, filled with intense devotion to Kedāra / and wishing to see Kedāra, arrived there. 39

5.116.s:
te tāṃ dṛṣṭvā samāyātāṃ bhaṭṭiṃkāṃ tāṃ dvijodbhavām ..
vismayena samāyuktāḥ papracchustadanaṃta ram..6.117.40...
ko'sau brāhmaṇarūpeṇa nāgaḥ prāptaḥ suśobhane ..
tena tvaṃ kutra nītāsi kimarthaṃ ca vadasva naḥ..4...
5.116.d:
ते तां दृष्ट्वा समायातां भट्टिंकां तां द्विजोद्भवाम् ..
विस्मयेन समायुक्ताः पप्रच्छुस्तदनंत रम्..6.117.40...
कोऽसौ ब्राह्मणरूपेण नागः प्राप्तः सुशोभने ..
तेन त्वं कुत्र नीतासि किमर्थं च वदस्व नः..4...
5.116.m:
Seeing that Bhaṭṭikā, born of a brahmin, who had arrived, / filled with astonishment, they immediately questioned her: 40
"O beautiful lady, who was that nāga who came in the form of a brahmin? / Where were you taken by him, and why? Tell us! 41

5.116.s:
kasmātpunaḥ pramuktā'si sarvaṃ vada yathātatham..
atra naḥ kautukaṃ jātaṃ sumahattava kāraṇāt..42..
5.116.d:
कस्मात्पुनः प्रमुक्ताऽसि सर्वं वद यथातथम्..
अत्र नः कौतुकं जातं सुमहत्तव कारणात्..42..
5.116.m: Why have you been released again? Tell everything as it happened! / A very great curiosity has arisen in us concerning you." 42

5.116.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
tataḥ sā kathayāmāsa sarvaṃ takṣakasaṃbhavam ..
vṛttāṃtaṃ nāgasaṃbhūtaṃ śāpānugrahajaṃ tathā .. 43 ..
5.116.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
ततः सा कथयामास सर्वं तक्षकसंभवम् ..
वृत्तांतं नागसंभूतं शापानुग्रहजं तथा .. 43 ..
5.116.m: Sūta said: / Then she related everything that had happened with Takṣaka, / the entire episode concerning the nāga, and the origin of the curses and the favors. 43

5.116.s:
etasminnaṃtare prāptaṃ sarvaṃ tasyāḥ kuṭumbakam ..
rorūyamāṇaṃ duḥkhārtaṃ śrutvā tāṃ tatra cāgatām .. 44 ..
5.116.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे प्राप्तं सर्वं तस्याः कुटुम्बकम् ..
रोरूयमाणं दुःखार्तं श्रुत्वा तां तत्र चागताम् .. 44 ..
5.116.m: Meanwhile, her entire family arrived, / weeping piteously and stricken with grief, having heard that she had returned there. 44

5.116.s:
atha sā jananī tasyā vāṣpa paryākulekṣaṇā ..
sasvaje tāṃ tathā cānyāḥ sakhyaḥ snigdhena cetasā .. 45 ..
5.116.d:
अथ सा जननी तस्या वाष्प पर्याकुलेक्षणा ..
सस्वजे तां तथा चान्याः सख्यः स्निग्धेन चेतसा .. 45 ..
5.116.m: Then her mother, her eyes overcome with tears, / embraced her, as did the other female friends with affectionate hearts. 45

5.116.s:
tato ninyurgṛhaṃ svaṃ ca śṛṇvaṃtaśca muhurmuhuḥ ..
nāgalokodbhavāṃ vārtāṃ visya yāviṣṭacetasaḥ .. 46 ..
5.116.d:
ततो निन्युर्गृहं स्वं च शृण्वंतश्च मुहुर्मुहुः ..
नागलोकोद्भवां वार्तां विस्य याविष्टचेतसः .. 46 ..
5.116.m: Then, their minds filled with astonishment, hearing repeatedly / the news of what had happened in the world of nāgas, they took her to their own home. 46

5.116.s:
atha tatra pure paurāḥ sarve procuḥ parasparam ..
ayuktaṃ kṛtametena brāhmaṇena durātmanā .. 47 ..
5.116.d:
अथ तत्र पुरे पौराः सर्वे प्रोचुः परस्परम् ..
अयुक्तं कृतमेतेन ब्राह्मणेन दुरात्मना .. 47 ..
5.116.m: Then all the citizens in that city said to one another: / "An improper deed has been done by this wicked brahmin, 47

5.116.s:
yadānītā sutaruṇī paraharmyoṣitā tayā? ..
anyeṣāmapi viprāṇāṃ saṃti nāryo hyanekaśaḥ .. 48 ..
5.116.d:
यदानीता सुतरुणी परहर्म्योषिता तया? ..
अन्येषामपि विप्राणां संति नार्यो ह्यनेकशः .. 48 ..
5.116.m: in that a young daughter who dwelt in another's mansion was brought back by him! / There are indeed numerous women belonging to other brahmins too— 48

5.116.s:
taruṇyo rūpavatyaśca vaidhavyena samanvitāḥ ..
tāsāmapi ca sarvāsāmeṣa nyāyo bhaviṣyati ..
yonisaṃkarajo nūnaṃ tasmānnirvāsyatāmiti .. 49 ..
5.116.d:
तरुण्यो रूपवत्यश्च वैधव्येन समन्विताः ..
तासामपि च सर्वासामेष न्यायो भविष्यति ..
योनिसंकरजो नूनं तस्मान्निर्वास्यतामिति .. 49 ..
5.116.m: young, beautiful, and afflicted with widowhood. / This will become the precedent for all of them as well, / undoubtedly giving rise to miscegenation; therefore, let him be exiled!" 49

5.116.s:
ekībhūya tataḥ sarve brāhmaṇaṃ taṃ dvijottamāḥ ..
sāmapūrvamidaṃ vākyaṃ procuḥ śāstra samudbhavam .. 6.117.50 ..
5.116.d:
एकीभूय ततः सर्वे ब्राह्मणं तं द्विजोत्तमाः ..
सामपूर्वमिदं वाक्यं प्रोचुः शास्त्र समुद्भवम् .. 6.117.50 ..
5.116.m: Then all those excellent brahmins gathered together / and spoke these concilatory words rooted in the scriptures to that brahmin: 50

5.116.s:
eṣā tava sutā vipra taruṇī rūpasaṃyutā ..
sānurāgeṇa nāgeṇa pātāle ca samāhṛtā .. 51 ..
5.116.d:
एषा तव सुता विप्र तरुणी रूपसंयुता ..
सानुरागेण नागेण पाताले च समाहृता .. 51 ..
5.116.m: "This daughter of yours, O brahmin, is young and endowed with beauty; / she was carried away to Pātāla by an impassioned nāga. 51

5.116.s:
tadvakṣyati pramuktāhaṃ nirdoṣā tena rāgiṇā ..
na śraddhāṃ yāti loko'yaṃ śuddhaiṣā samudāhṛtā 52 ..
5.116.d:
तद्वक्ष्यति प्रमुक्ताहं निर्दोषा तेन रागिणा ..
न श्रद्धां याति लोकोऽयं शुद्धैषा समुदाहृता 52 ..
5.116.m: Though she will say, 'I was released faultless by that passionate one,' / this world will not believe it, even if she is declared pure. 52

5.116.s:
tasmācchuddhiṃ dvijedrāṇāṃ prayacchatu dvijottama ..
yenānyeṣāmapi prājña vinaśyaṃti na yoṣitaḥ .. 53 ..
5.116.d:
तस्माच्छुद्धिं द्विजेद्राणां प्रयच्छतु द्विजोत्तम ..
येनान्येषामपि प्राज्ञ विनश्यंति न योषितः .. 53 ..
5.116.m: Therefore, O best of brahmins, offer proof of purification to the lords of the twice-born, / so that, wise one, the women of others may not be ruined." 53

5.116.s:
bāḍhamityeva sa proktvā tatastāṃ vijane sutām ..
papraccha yadi te doṣaḥ kaścidasti prakīrtaya.. 54 ..
5.116.d:
बाढमित्येव स प्रोक्त्वा ततस्तां विजने सुताम् ..
पप्रच्छ यदि ते दोषः कश्चिदस्ति प्रकीर्तय.. 54 ..
5.116.m: Saying, "So be it," he then questioned his daughter in private: / "If there is any fault in you, speak out! 54

5.116.s: no cetprayaccha saṃśuddhiṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ pratuṣṭaye .. 55 ..
5.116.d: नो चेत्प्रयच्छ संशुद्धिं ब्राह्मणानां प्रतुष्टये .. 55 ..
5.116.m: If not, provide proof of purification for the satisfaction of the brahmins." 55

5.116.s:
.. bhaṭṭikovāca .. ..
yuktamuktaṃ tvayā tāta tathānyairapi ca dvijaiḥ ..
yuktā syādyoṣitaḥ śuddhirdvārātikramaṇādapi.. .. .. 56 ..
5.116.d:
.. भट्टिकोवाच .. ..
युक्तमुक्तं त्वया तात तथान्यैरपि च द्विजैः ..
युक्ता स्याद्योषितः शुद्धिर्द्वारातिक्रमणादपि.. .. .. 56 ..
5.116.m: Bhaṭṭikā said: / "What you have said is proper, father, and so also what was said by the other brahmins. / Purification is proper for a woman merely from crossing the threshold, 56

5.116.s:
kiṃ punaḥ paradeśaṃ ca gatāyā rāgiṇā saha ..
tasmādahaṃ na saṃdehaḥ prātaḥ snātā hutāśanam .. 57 ..
5.116.d:
किं पुनः परदेशं च गताया रागिणा सह ..
तस्मादहं न संदेहः प्रातः स्नाता हुताशनम् .. 57 ..
5.116.m: how much more for one who has gone to another land with an impassioned man! / Therefore, having bathed in the morning, beyond doubt, I [shall enter] the fire..." 57

5.116.s:
praviśya sarvaviprāṇāṃ śuddhiṃ dāsyāmya saṃśayam ..
ahamatra ca pānaṃ ca yaccānyadapi kiṃcana ..
prāśayiṣyāmi saṃprāpya śuddhiṃ caiva hutāśanāt .. 58 ..
5.116.d:
प्रविश्य सर्वविप्राणां शुद्धिं दास्याम्य संशयम् ..
अहमत्र च पानं च यच्चान्यदपि किंचन ..
प्राशयिष्यामि संप्राप्य शुद्धिं चैव हुताशनात् .. 58 ..
5.116.m: "Entering [the fire], I will give proof of purity beyond doubt to all the brahmins. / Here, after attaining purity from the fire, / I will cause [them] to take food and whatever else [they desire]."

5.116.s:
evamuktastayā so'tha harṣeṇa mahatānvitaḥ ..
prātarutthāya dārūṇi purabāhye nyayojayat .. 59 ..
5.116.d:
एवमुक्तस्तया सोऽथ हर्षेण महतान्वितः ..
प्रातरुत्थाय दारूणि पुरबाह्ये न्ययोजयत् .. 59 ..
5.116.m: Addressed thus by her, he then was filled with great joy. / Having risen in the morning, he arranged firewood outside the city.

5.116.s:
bhaṭṭikā'pi tataḥ snātvā śuklāṃbaradharā śuciḥ ..
sarvaiḥ parijanaiḥ sārdhaṃ tathā nija kuṭuṃbakaiḥ .. 6.117.60 ..
5.116.d:
भट्टिकाऽपि ततः स्नात्वा शुक्लांबरधरा शुचिः ..
सर्वैः परिजनैः सार्धं तथा निज कुटुंबकैः .. 6.117.60 ..
5.116.m: Then Bhaṭṭikā too, having bathed, wearing white garments, pure, / together with all her attendants and her own family,

5.116.s:
prasannavadanā hṛṣṭā viṣṇudhyānaparāyaṇā ..
jagāma tatra yatrāste sumahāndāruparvataḥ .. 61 ..
5.116.d:
प्रसन्नवदना हृष्टा विष्णुध्यानपरायणा ..
जगाम तत्र यत्रास्ते सुमहान्दारुपर्वतः .. 61 ..
5.116.m: cheerful-faced, joyful, devoted to meditation on Viṣṇu, / went there where that immense mountain of wood stood.

5.116.s:
tato vahniṃ samādhāya svayaṃ tatra dvijottamāḥ..
pradakṣiṇātrayaṃ kṛtvā prāha caiva kṛtāṃjaliḥ .. 62 .
5.116.d:
ततो वह्निं समाधाय स्वयं तत्र द्विजोत्तमाः..
प्रदक्षिणात्रयं कृत्वा प्राह चैव कृतांजलिः .. 62 .
5.116.m: Then, O best of brahmins, after kindling the fire herself there, / having circumambulated it thrice, she spoke with joined palms:

5.116.s:
yadi me'sti kvaciddoṣaḥ kāmajo'lpo'pi gātrake ..
kṛto vā'pi balāttena takṣakeṇa durātmanā .. 63 ..
5.116.d:
यदि मेऽस्ति क्वचिद्दोषः कामजोऽल्पोऽपि गात्रके ..
कृतो वाऽपि बलात्तेन तक्षकेण दुरात्मना .. 63 ..
5.116.m: "If there is any fault born of desire anywhere in my body, even the slightest, / or one committed by force by that wicked Takṣaka,

5.116.s:
anyenāpi ca kenāpi bhaviṣyatyathavā paraḥ ..
tasmātpradahatu kṣipraṃ samiddho'yaṃ hutāśanaḥ .. 64
5.116.d:
अन्येनापि च केनापि भविष्यत्यथवा परः ..
तस्मात्प्रदहतु क्षिप्रं समिद्धोऽयं हुताशनः .. 64
5.116.m: or if another [fault] by any other person should exist, / therefore let this kindled fire burn me quickly!"

5.116.s:
evamuktvā'tha sā sādhvī praviṣṭā nijaharmyavat ..
susamiddho huto vahnirjāto jalamayaḥ kṣaṇāt .. 65 ..
5.116.d:
एवमुक्त्वाऽथ सा साध्वी प्रविष्टा निजहर्म्यवत् ..
सुसमिद्धो हुतो वह्निर्जातो जलमयः क्षणात् .. 65 ..
5.116.m: Having spoken thus, that virtuous woman then entered as if into her own mansion. / The well-kindled fire offering instantly became composed of water,

5.116.s:
sā ca paśyati cātmānaṃ jalamadhyagatāṃ śubhā .80
papātā'tha mahāvṛṣṭiḥ kusumānāṃ nabhastalāt .. 66 ..
devadūto vimānastha idaṃ vākyamuvāca ha ..
śuddhāsi tvaṃ mahābhāge cāritrai rnijagātrajaiḥ .. 67 ..
na tvayā sadṛśī cānyā kācinnārī bhaviṣyati ..
tisraḥ koṭyordhakoṭī ca yāni lomāni mānuṣe ..
prabhavaṃti mahābhāge sarvagātreṣu sarvadā .. 68 .
teṣāṃ madhye na te sādhvi pāpamekamapi kvacit .
tasmācchīghraṃ grahaṃ gaccha nijaṃ bāṃdhavasaṃyutā .. 69 ..
kuru kṛtyāni puṇyāni samārādhaya keśavam ..
etaccaiva citeḥ sthānaṃ tvadīyaṃ jalapūritam .. 6.117.70 ..
tava nāmnā suvikhyātaṃ tīrthaṃ loke bhaviṣyati ..
ye'tra snānaṃ kariṣyaṃti śayane bodhane hareḥ .. 71 ..
te yāsyaṃti parāṃ siddhiṃ duṣprāpyā yā'marairapi ..
uktvaivaṃ viratā vāṇī devadūtasamudbhavā .. 72 ..
5.116.d:
सा च पश्यति चात्मानं जलमध्यगतां शुभा .80
पपाताऽथ महावृष्टिः कुसुमानां नभस्तलात् .. 66 ..
देवदूतो विमानस्थ इदं वाक्यमुवाच ह ..
शुद्धासि त्वं महाभागे चारित्रै र्निजगात्रजैः .. 67 ..
न त्वया सदृशी चान्या काचिन्नारी भविष्यति ..
तिस्रः कोट्योर्धकोटी च यानि लोमानि मानुषे ..
प्रभवंति महाभागे सर्वगात्रेषु सर्वदा .. 68 .
तेषां मध्ये न ते साध्वि पापमेकमपि क्वचित् .
तस्माच्छीघ्रं ग्रहं गच्छ निजं बांधवसंयुता .. 69 ..
कुरु कृत्यानि पुण्यानि समाराधय केशवम् ..
एतच्चैव चितेः स्थानं त्वदीयं जलपूरितम् .. 6.117.70 ..
तव नाम्ना सुविख्यातं तीर्थं लोके भविष्यति ..
येऽत्र स्नानं करिष्यंति शयने बोधने हरेः .. 71 ..
ते यास्यंति परां सिद्धिं दुष्प्राप्या याऽमरैरपि ..
उक्त्वैवं विरता वाणी देवदूतसमुद्भवा .. 72 ..
5.116.m:
and the auspicious woman saw herself standing in the midst of water.
Then a great rain of flowers fell from the sky.
A messenger of the gods, seated in an aerial chariot, spoke these words: / "You are pure, O highly fortunate one, by your conduct born of your own body.
No other woman will ever be equal to you. / The three and a half crores of hairs that / exist on all the limbs of a human being at all times, O highly fortunate one—
among them, O virtuous woman, you do not have even a single sin anywhere. / Therefore go quickly to your own house accompanied by your kinsmen.
Perform meritorious deeds; worship Keśava. / And this place of your funeral pyre, filled with water,
shall become a sacred ford well-known in the world by your name. / Those who take a ritual ablution here on the sleeping and waking [days] of Hari,
they shall attain the supreme perfection, which is difficult even for the immortals to achieve." / Having spoken thus, the voice arising from the messenger of the gods ceased.

5.116.s:
bhaṭṭikā tu tato hṛṣṭā praṇamya janakaṃ nijam ..
nāhaṃ gṛhaṃ gamiṣyāmi kiṃ kariṣyāmyahaṃ gṛhe .. 73 ..
atraivārādhayiṣyāmi nijatīrthe sadā'cyu tam ..
tathā tapaḥ kariṣyāmi bhikṣānnakṛtabhojanā .. 74 ..
tasmāttāta gṛhaṃ gaccha sthitā'haṃ cāgra saṃśraye .. 75 ..
tataḥ sa janakastasyāste vā'pi puravāsinaḥ ..
saṃprahṛṣṭā gṛhaṃ jagmuḥ śaṃsatastāṃ pṛthakpṛthak .. 76 ..
tayā traivikramī tatra pratimā prāgvinirmitā ..
paścānmāheśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ kṛtvā prāsādamuttamam .. 77 ..
tataḥ paraṃ tapaścakre bhikṣānnakṛtabhojanā ..
śasyamānā janaiḥ sarvaiścamatkārapurodbhavaiḥ .. 78 ..
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
etadvaḥ sarvamākhyātaṃ yatpṛṣṭo'smi dvijottamāḥ ..
yathā tasyā dṛḍhaṃ kāyamabhedyaṃ saṃsthitaṃ sadā .. 79 ..
5.116.d:
भट्टिका तु ततो हृष्टा प्रणम्य जनकं निजम् ..
नाहं गृहं गमिष्यामि किं करिष्याम्यहं गृहे .. 73 ..
अत्रैवाराधयिष्यामि निजतीर्थे सदाऽच्यु तम् ..
तथा तपः करिष्यामि भिक्षान्नकृतभोजना .. 74 ..
तस्मात्तात गृहं गच्छ स्थिताऽहं चाग्र संश्रये .. 75 ..
ततः स जनकस्तस्यास्ते वाऽपि पुरवासिनः ..
संप्रहृष्टा गृहं जग्मुः शंसतस्तां पृथक्पृथक् .. 76 ..
तया त्रैविक्रमी तत्र प्रतिमा प्राग्विनिर्मिता ..
पश्चान्माहेश्वरं लिंगं कृत्वा प्रासादमुत्तमम् .. 77 ..
ततः परं तपश्चक्रे भिक्षान्नकृतभोजना ..
शस्यमाना जनैः सर्वैश्चमत्कारपुरोद्भवैः .. 78 ..
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
एतद्वः सर्वमाख्यातं यत्पृष्टोऽस्मि द्विजोत्तमाः ..
यथा तस्या दृढं कायमभेद्यं संस्थितं सदा .. 79 ..
5.116.m:
Then Bhaṭṭikā, overjoyed, bowed to her father [and said]: / "I will not go home; what shall I do at home?
Right here at my own sacred ford I will always worship Acyuta, / and I will practice austerity, taking food gained by begging alms.
Therefore, father, go home; I shall remain dwelling in front."
Then her father as well as those citizens, / greatly delighted, went home, praising her each in their own way.
By her an image of Trivikrama was first fashioned there; / afterward, having made an excellent temple [and] a liṅga of Maheśvara,
she then performed supreme austerity, taking food gained by begging alms, / praised by all the people originating from the city of Camatkāra.
Sūta said: / All this has been related to you, since I was asked, O best of brahmins, / how her body remained firm and impenetrable at all times,

5.116.s:
sarpāṇāṃ ca tathā'nyeṣāṃ śastrādīnāmapi dvijāḥ ..
yaścaitatpaṭhate nityaṃ bhaṭṭikākhyānamuttamam ..
nāpavādo bhavettasya kukṛto dvijasattamāḥ .. 6.117.80 ..
5.116.d:
सर्पाणां च तथाऽन्येषां शस्त्रादीनामपि द्विजाः ..
यश्चैतत्पठते नित्यं भट्टिकाख्यानमुत्तमम् ..
नापवादो भवेत्तस्य कुकृतो द्विजसत्तमाः .. 6.117.80 ..
5.116.m: against serpents and likewise against other weapons and the like, O brahmins. / And whoever recites daily this excellent narrative of Bhaṭṭikā, / no ill-repute arising from misdeeds shall befall him, O best of brahmins.

5.116.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṃḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye bhaṭṭikātīrthotpattimāhātmyakathanaṃnāma saptadaśottaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. .. 117 .. .. cha ..
5.116.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखंडे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये भट्टिकातीर्थोत्पत्तिमाहात्म्यकथनंनाम सप्तदशोत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. .. 117 .. .. छ ..
5.116.m: Thus ends the one hundred and seventeenth chapter, entitled 'Narration of the origin and māhātmya of Bhaṭṭikātīrtha' in the Māhātmya of the Hāṭakeśvarakṣetra, in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [section], in the Skandamahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses.

5.117.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
yattvayā sūtaja proktaṃ takṣakaḥ saṃbhaviṣyati ..
saurāṣṭraviṣaye rājā raivatākhyo mahābalaḥ .. 1 ..
5.117.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
यत्त्वया सूतज प्रोक्तं तक्षकः संभविष्यति ..
सौराष्ट्रविषये राजा रैवताख्यो महाबलः .. 1 ..
5.117.m: The seers said: / As to what was told by you, O son of Sūta, that Takṣaka would be born / in the country of Saurāṣṭra as a mighty king named Raivata,

5.117.s:
tathā tasya priyā bhāryo nāmnā kṣemaṃkarīti yā ..
ānartādhipaterharmye saṃbhaviṣyati bhāminī .. 2 ..
5.117.d:
तथा तस्य प्रिया भार्यो नाम्ना क्षेमंकरीति या ..
आनर्ताधिपतेर्हर्म्ये संभविष्यति भामिनी .. 2 ..
5.117.m: and that his beloved wife named Kṣemaṃkarī, / that beautiful woman, would be born in the palace of the lord of Ānarta—

5.117.s:
tābhyāṃ sarvaṃ samācakṣva vṛttāṃtaṃ sūtanaṃdana ..
atra naḥ kautukaṃ jātaṃ vicitraṃ jalpatastava .. 3 ..
5.117.d:
ताभ्यां सर्वं समाचक्ष्व वृत्तांतं सूतनंदन ..
अत्र नः कौतुकं जातं विचित्रं जल्पतस्तव .. 3 ..
5.117.m: tell us that whole account concerning the two, O joy of Sūta. / Curiosity has arisen in us here as you speak of strange things.

5.117.s:
kedāraśca śruto'smābhiḥ sūtaputra himācale ..

केदारश्च श्रुतोऽस्माभिः सूतपुत्र हिमाचले ..
स कथं तत्र संजातः सर्वं विस्तरतो वद .. 4.. ..
5.117.m: And Kedāra in the Himālayas has been heard of by us, O son of Sūta; / how did it appear there? Tell everything in detail.

5.117.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
atra vaḥ kīrtayiṣyāmi sarvaṃ brāhmaṇasattamāḥ ..
yathā mayā śrutaṃ pūrvaṃ nijatātamukhāddvijāḥ .. 6 ..
pūrvaṃ tacchāpadoṣeṇa takṣako dharaṇītale ..
saurāṣṭrādhipaterharmye raivatākhyo babhūva ha .. 6 ..

अत्र वः कीर्तयिष्यामि सर्वं ब्राह्मणसत्तमाः ..

सौराष्ट्राधिपतेर्हर्म्ये रैवताख्यो बभूव ह .. 6 ..
5.117.m:
Sūta said: / In this regard I shall proclaim everything to you, O best of brahmins, / as it was heard by me formerly from the mouth of my own father, O brahmins.
Formerly, by the fault of that curse, Takṣaka on the surface of the earth / was indeed born in the palace of the lord of Saurāṣṭra under the name Raivata.

5.117.s:
ānarttādhipateścāpi saṃjātā tanayā gṛhe ..
tasyāścāpi suvikhyātaṃ nāma jātaṃ dharātale .. 7 ..
5.117.d:
आनर्त्ताधिपतेश्चापि संजाता तनया गृहे ..
तस्याश्चापि सुविख्यातं नाम जातं धरातले .. 7 ..
5.117.m: And in the house of the lord of Ānarta a daughter was born; / and she received a well-known name on the surface of the earth,

5.117.s:
kṣemaṃkarīti viprendrāḥ karmaṇā prakaṭīkṛtam ..
ānartādhipatiḥ pūrvamāsīdrājā prabhaṃjanaḥ .. 8 ..
5.117.d:
क्षेमंकरीति विप्रेन्द्राः कर्मणा प्रकटीकृतम् ..
आनर्ताधिपतिः पूर्वमासीद्राजा प्रभंजनः .. 8 ..
5.117.m: Kṣemaṃkarī, O chiefs of brahmins, made evident by her deed. / Formerly, the lord of Ānarta was King Prabhañjana.

5.117.s:
tasya vairaṃ samutpannaṃ bahubhiḥ saha bhūmipaiḥ ..
